body:
An overview of President Trump's executive orders so far
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**January 26, 2025** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
In just a short time back in office, President Trump has taken bold and sweeping action through a series of executive orders that aim to transform America’s direction. These orders reflect his commitment to reversing policies from the previous administration, tackling urgent national priorities, and reaffirming his "America First" agenda.
Key highlights of his executive actions include declaring a **national energy emergency** , a move to fast-track domestic oil and gas production and reduce environmental restrictions. He’s also withdrawn the U.S. from the Paris Climate Agreement once again, aligning energy policy with national security and economic growth goals.
On immigration, President Trump reinstated the **"Remain in Mexico" policy** , declared a national emergency at the southern border, and moved to end birthright citizenship for children of undocumented immigrants—a decision that will undoubtedly face legal challenges.
Another prominent focus has been **dismantling federal diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives**. By ending these programs across federal agencies, Trump signaled a shift back to merit-based hiring and traditional policies that recognize only two biological sexes in official documentation.
He also pardoned over a thousand individuals involved in the **January 6th Capitol events** while issuing orders to end the weaponization of government in what he describes as a necessary measure to restore public trust in federal agencies.
For more details on these executive orders and their potential impact, check out a [full list here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and stay tuned for our in-depth coverage at Rocky Mountain Voice. As these actions shape the national dialogue, we’ll continue to provide clear, factual reporting on how they affect Colorado and the nation.
Thank you for being part of this community and staying informed.
In liberty and truth, Heidi Ganahl

The Electronic Registration Information Center, also known as ERIC, is a nonprofit system that helps participating states keep their registration rolls accurate and up to date by analyzing voter data and sharing reports with members , in order for them to update their voter rolls, remove ineligible voters and investigate potential voter fraud.
States from Florida, West Virginia and Missouri to Alabama, Louisiana and Texas withdrew in the last few years. Virginia withdrew as well, and after the state legislature passed a bill this year to rejoin, their governor, an opponent of voting rights, vetoed the bill. Critics of the withdrawals have argued that leaving ERIC will make it harder to verify that voter rolls are up to date in each state .

Peter --[](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/?e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_okgop_lincoln_day_dinner&n=2) We at the Oklahoma OKGOP are excited to announce this years Lincoln Day Dinner to be held on the evening of February 28, 2025, at 7:00 pm in the Embassy Church Ballroom located in Tulsa. This years event promises to be an entertaining, informative and unique experience as we will be having Mr. Larry Elliott, an Abraham Lincoln portrayer along with his wife as Mary Lincoln. Together they will take you first person from the birth of our 16th President through his life, the battle to save our republic and ultimately to his tragic death at Ford’s Theater at the hands of assassin John Wilkes Booth. Mr. Elliott has performed as President Lincoln for over 20 years and remains in full character throughout the entire evening helping to create the illusion of having the President right there in the room with you. It is our intent for this event to bring a clear focus on the 16th President, his life and the monumental impact this man had on our nation’s history. Additionally invitations are being sent to all members of the Oklahoma Congressional Delegation and will be emceed by Dr. Howard Hatcher. We hope that you will join us for the one of a kind experience and believe you will find this program to be a very enjoyable and memorable night. Create Peace Through Strength**](http://links.conservativeum.com/u/click?_t=26c2e4aa9bbe40418f61e26972138f21&_m=c80c714f392e42008e9535002969ab71&_e=OarO0HzGQVJNipQ79cTH_kU84fgBgjqqD5K9CLuAamNKy2VSrRe39SJzK6QMJDs72S6dAmpOBWlK-UVD5UVMZWcuRLiE0TIeeKweF8Z9ICTDt9E8IqHKHMfr54vLw514WJ1EaowqDOa_H_NSRAwEwl8SEBFBVGEzx0P07jGsej3WGAy6EZ3cT7ISlpmPEG2CM09Qjh0Vi-g-ZLuFJZQX8E-FQ_wqEKeJm_VEW8xD3Z-5JE6LOBmdhUnbj1Eq9QtvyTTAl9PXw3U1ORSP4AdRftX04CuE8ZyFomul0nJQjQu6in7Ka0QB9IjumsV5teD4VHpNiT1TkvY3_bG9Jnsc5UgTPhyDP-bGi1cyeTvVePQsrtXrxMEvdb5q8o2stNMNps48OvqTmJUb15CrtpXH2T-zHWju5D-C_v-ChwZPvLk_qREQRbOZe3IU7Sb21WuexFLspkfPt6pJf8OgtCptPLBelm8uUJ1aX-LJxvGTzr3gv3EjTOB_n24W6i5_gR6HgB1UItSFZvtcbehD05FCbeE3XTrElO5q6qk1um1A-8U%3D)** Our military must make good on its promises, and America must command respect across the globe. If our military and its leaders aren’t strong, we will NEVER see peace again. **[**5\. Washington Democrats have stolen your future and the future of your children by overspending trillions of dollars. The value of our dollar will NEVER recover and will continue to lose value unless we cut spending like it’s hair in a barbershop. But if we simply spend less than we take in, we WILL restore our value and create hope for the future. **[**6\. Everyone knows this. It’s not some secret that you learn at an Ivy League Business School. If we cut taxes and eliminate ridiculous regulations, our economy will boom. Washington Democrats have stolen your future and the future of your children by overspending trillions of dollars. My Dear Friend, My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’m writing to you because I’ve spent the last eight years fighting tooth and nail to keep school-appointed counselors, and out-of-control judges from transitioning my son James against my will and against all reason.You may have heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or on Fox News.I am James’s father, but because I refused to accept that my 5 YEAR OLD boy should be surgically and chemically castrated......I’ve watched the school system, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.Just recently, an LA Court ruled that my ex-wife is free to proceed with castrating my son James. That’s why I’m writing to you today. **[I need your help.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=747e869686634476b5fffcf892939352&_e=l0o8UOhLgGk9XXXWQzehvVvXlitmRyz81G9XwGV9FhIMIRRom-reoFLoFbLkd_tx4SJAjxVe2eH018AWYglnVM1UWFFg1jYOpRe_opwUxqm_EX94GXGI4cLImD8Fj3P5QT_rwqjhSZHakGO2cHwqv8bTOfsk4hmESuL1uxBIE5KmmsxOIrAVHXoEsnpkty5WP6CK-yPnq_EE8ya_Te1URabCx-yyX6YT_ZX2JKzTOkOpf8nZDhUKfRlFgShSRGhKODeqSL_ZPmfgXHfcRV3nqdNhXmYyop7F6p4dUdDpNFBjAILjr6OmAB1O0a53XOHgVdPPU02KLaVpECBwY4UHK5nFXdIzAI4oEqjicEimwjUpXKqrIShQ3JEKJvwv2O97)** I’m up against radical trans-activist judges, the 6 BILLION dollar trans lobby, and coastal elites forcing their LGBTQ+ agenda down our throats. They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees... They’re trying to break my spirit... I want to keep fighting, but I can’t do it alone. If you’re with me in the fight to **Save James** , **[would you consider making a generous $25 contribution to my Legal Defense Fund today?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=747e869686634476b5fffcf892939352&_e=l0o8UOhLgGk9XXXWQzehvVvXlitmRyz81G9XwGV9FhIMIRRom-reoFLoFbLkd_tx4SJAjxVe2eH018AWYglnVM1UWFFg1jYOpRe_opwUxqm_EX94GXGI4cLImD8Fj3P5QT_rwqjhSZHakGO2cHwqv8bTOfsk4hmESuL1uxBIE5KmmsxOIrAVHXoEsnpkty5WP6CK-yPnq_EE8ya_Te1URabCx-yyX6YT_ZX2JKzTOkMbAKVy-Nv8nOxv4FSlNvvrUB-shiHCoHaa-C7a3G1Poh8YVY4_cqPhe88JxoAb3p2AP0flwDKW9EQYLjAXRGC5Td_pujBOuBtAfTA7bRP0YBP8fiNjyAsNOtRT8QH1That8VWP7YP_hlKZ68J5dc_9)** But I’m getting ahead of myself...Let me start at the beginning. When James was just two years old, my ex-wife began saying our boy James was actually a girl.I told her she was wrong, and I kept dropping my son off at school in boy’s clothes because **he is a boy**. (I can’t believe I have to say that.) I later found out that the school counselors were changing him into girl’s clothes once he got to school WITHOUT MY KNOWLEDGE to inflame this delusion.Then during the custody battle, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.The court-mandated supervisor would ONLY let me see James if I put him in girl’s clothes. I have never affirmed the lie that my son is a girl, nor will I ever affirm it.So I was forced to stop visiting him.It broke my heart.**Do you see what we’re up against?** I can confirm that these trans-activist judges are presiding over kangaroo courts where common sense goes right out the window.They need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** from their butchery.**[THAT’S why I need your help.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=747e869686634476b5fffcf892939352&_e=l0o8UOhLgGk9XXXWQzehvVvXlitmRyz81G9XwGV9FhIMIRRom-reoFLoFbLkd_tx4SJAjxVe2eH018AWYglnVM1UWFFg1jYOpRe_opwUxqm_EX94GXGI4cLImD8Fj3P5QT_rwqjhSZHakGO2cHwqv8bTOfsk4hmESuL1uxBIE5KmmsxOIrAVHXoEsnpkty5WP6CK-yPnq_EE8ya_Te1URabCx-yyX6YT_ZX2JKzTOkOJ1DSB3sf2mzs6n2lTWp5iiu8tMZ90-hJauIBeP0GrcYqQ4e1xiSD35k_TyhpjEHKzNHY7jMNhemsdqJb5kK_IQQiJv1EuNK4VZ9arPItv1cRJFr--68M7G00xhEXikYPUXuOKysdsy14CVd_Sa04f)** I am under a gag order currently to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Obviously, I’m not abiding by that order because it’s blatantly unconstitutional.But that’s not even the point.If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time. But I’m not just some activist.I’m a Dad.I’m fighting to save my son.And I will never give up on **James**.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers. I authored the bill in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee that outlawed sex change surgeries for minors.I then spent every dollar I had to make sure cowardly politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair. I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, but then my ex-wife just took James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state.And there was nothing I could do to stop it.And that’s the scary part:**If this can happen in Texas, it can happen anywhere.** Then in California, the radical judge railroaded me and gave my ex-wife free reign to proceed with the castration.I can’t even appeal the case because he sealed all the court records...I’ll have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process...On top of that, the other side is trying to make ME pay THEIR legal fees...**Do you see what we’re up against?** But if Conservatives won’t put up a fight, how will we ever win? I'm on a push to get more voters registered in my Congressional District (NY-21). More specifically, I am on a push to get people in NY-21 who are registered as Independent voters to register to vote as Democrats.
### NY-21 is huge -- all or part of 15 counties
Forgive me if I am repeating information you already know, but I need to say this: a lot of NY-21 voters do not realize how big the district is. NY-21 is all or part of 15 counties, sprawled over 15,000 square miles. The counties are: Clinton, Essex, Franklin, Fulton, Hamilton, Herkimer, part of Jefferson, Lewis, part of Montgomery, part of Oneida, part of Saratoga, Schoharie, St. Lawrence, Warren, and Washington.
Congressional Districts are mapped out by population. NY-21 is huge because it took that many square miles to get the 767,195 people required to form a Congressional District. But with communities that are not as densely-populated as some other parts of the state are, the dynamics are different. What works elsewhere simply does not work in NY-21
The flexibility that you might have as a voter to register as an Independent does not apply here. It might work elsewhere -- but it's hurting us here.
**The Democrats need you. The whole darn country needs you.**
NY-21 voters: if we lived in downtown Buffalo, or New York City, or Albany, or even in parts of the Hudson Valley, we could afford to make a statement with our voter registrations.
We do not.
Our Democratic Blue fades to a pale blue and then quickly into pink and deep red. Your switch from Independent to Democrat could start to change that.
To turn the tide in NY-21, Democrats need much more of a partisan presence in NY-21.
### There is strength in numbers
There is also safety in numbers. And this MAGA stuff -- it's gotten real.
The presence of more registered Democrats will build strength, courage, and coalition in communities throughout the North Country. Nobody likes to be the lone Dem in an otherwise red neighborhood. Stronger numbers of known Democrats will help fend off some of the hateful MAGA harassment such as [what we saw last week in Fulton County.](https://substack.com/redirect/2db33070-6800-4646-803c-d23580e3ad82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I understand that you might be thinking that I'm giving you even more reason to register as an Independent, rather than as a Democrat. Please -- step forward in courage; don't hide in fear. We need to show other non-MAGA community members that they are not alone. With more Independent voters than registered Democrats, that isn't so obvious.
### I am very grateful to my non-Democratic volunteers
Don't get me wrong: some of my most motivated volunteers are registered Independents and Republicans. When I was campaigning in the months leading up to the November 2024 election, a number of my volunteers explained that they were registered Republicans so that they would be able to participate in local town and county politics. I get it. I honestly don't know how to square that, except to say that if you did that for some strategic reason years ago, please consider whether you could change that now.
Other volunteers and supporters were registered as Independents or Blanks. They were not going to vote for the MAGAs, but they were so mad at the Democrats, they did not want to identify as Democrats on the voter roles either.
The votes of non-Democrats, their financial support, their time and talent, are all really appreciated.
Some people promised me that if the Democrats ever invested money into the congressional races in NY-21 they would start to re-consider registering as Democrats.
### Here's the problem
It's a chicken or egg situation. (No connection with the bird flu, thankfully.)
NY-21 has the following:
> 213,743 active Republican + Conservative Party voters
> 132,559 active Dem + Working Families Party voters
> 145,971 active Blank or Independent voters
A simple Google search on Independent Voters led me to an organization whose contact information leads us to Shushan, New York, which is in Washington County, and in NY-21. [IndependentVoting.org](https://substack.com/redirect/a9f5d07a-201f-4544-ba40-eefffce97273?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) claims to offer a path forward for voters who are frustrated with the traditional Red and Blue parties.
It's an attractive idea: avoid partisan politics, choose candidates based on who they are, rather than their party affiliation, and don't play in to the big-machine political parties.
But it is killing us in rural districts. With re-districting, my success in getting more voters than any Democrat has ever gotten before in the NY-21 race was matched with a 2.5% drop in margins compared to the guy who ran in the midterms. Clearly we need to turn things around.
Volunteer, canvas, phone bank, send postcards. Yes - we need you and we appreciate you. But I need for you to at least consider doing this one step more, and change your voter registration so that you are a registered Democrat.
Do ya hear me -- at least _**consider**_ it.
### I'm talking to YOU
And definitely, if you are someone who has groused loudly and repeatedly about how the Democratic Party ignores NY-21, I urge you to take care of this voter registration thing right now.
It's a risk. You might tell me to go jump. And if you make the decision to maintain your status as an Independent voter, then so be it.
But like we say to non-voters, then you lose the license to complain. In this case, you lose the ability to criticize the state Democratic party for failing to put money into races in rural districts. In other words, kindly shut up! (Harsh, I know. My mother would scold me for saying that to somebody.) No political party needs to send money to your congressional district if you can't be bothered to register with that party.
### This is a big "ask" and I know it
I understand that this is a big "ask", and goes against the grain of most North Country thinking. But until we can address the disparity in numbers between the Democratic-leaning voters and the Republican-leaning voters, we will see more results like we have seen since Trump took his famous escalator ride. (We should have known then - it was a down escalator. Pretty symbolic, right?)
And it's not just NY-21. Across the country, we need every non-MAGA-aligned voter in these ruby-red counties to consider registering as a Democrat in order for the state and national Democratic Parties to start to make investments for Special Elections in 2025, the mid-terms in 2026, and the General Election in 2028 (which can't get here fast enough!).
### You can change your party registration here

NY-21 is peach-colored. I'm on a push to get more voters registered in my Congressional District (NY-21). More specifically, I am on a push to get people in NY-21 who are registered as Independent voters to register to vote as Democrats. NY-21 is huge -- all or part of 15 counties Forgive me if I am repeating information you already know, but I need to say this: a lot of NY-21 voters do not realize how big the district is. NY-21 is all or part of 15 counties, sprawled over 15,000 square miles. The counties are: Clinton, Essex, Franklin, Fulton, Hamilton, Herkimer, part of Jefferson, Lewis, part of Montgomery, part of Oneida, part of Saratoga, Schoharie, St. Lawrence, Warren, and Washington. Congressional Districts are mapped out by population. NY-21 is huge because it took that many square miles to get the 767,195 people required to form a Congressional District. But with communities that are not as densely-populated as some other parts of the state are, the dynamics are different. What works elsewhere simply does not work in NY-21 The flexibility that you might have as a voter to register as an Independent does not apply here. It might work elsewhere -- but it's hurting us here. The Democrats need you. The whole darn country needs you. NY-21 voters: if we lived in downtown Buffalo, or New York City, or Albany, or even in parts of the Hudson Valley, we could afford to make a statement with our voter registrations. We do not. Our Democratic Blue fades to a pale blue and then quickly into pink and deep red. Your switch from Independent to Democrat could start to change that. To turn the tide in NY-21, Democrats need much more of a partisan presence in NY-21. There is strength in numbers There is also safety in numbers. And this MAGA stuff -- it's gotten real. The presence of more registered Democrats will build strength, courage, and coalition in communities throughout the North Country. Nobody likes to be the lone Dem in an otherwise red neighborhood. Stronger numbers of known Democrats will help fend off some of the hateful MAGA harassment such as I understand that you might be thinking that I'm giving you even more reason to register as an Independent, rather than as a Democrat. Please -- step forward in courage; don't hide in fear. We need to show other non-MAGA community members that they are not alone. With more Independent voters than registered Democrats, that isn't so obvious. I am very grateful to my non-Democratic volunteers Don't get me wrong: some of my most motivated volunteers are registered Independents and Republicans. When I was campaigning in the months leading up to the November 2024 election, a number of my volunteers explained that they were registered Republicans so that they would be able to participate in local town and county politics. I get it. I honestly don't know how to square that, except to say that if you did that for some strategic reason years ago, please consider whether you could change that now. Other volunteers and supporters were registered as Independents or Blanks. They were not going to vote for the MAGAs, but they were so mad at the Democrats, they did not want to identify as Democrats on the voter roles either. The votes of non-Democrats, their financial support, their time and talent, are all really appreciated. Some people promised me that if the Democrats ever invested money into the congressional races in NY-21 they would start to re-consider registering as Democrats. Here's the problem It's a chicken or egg situation. (No connection with the bird flu, thankfully.) NY-21 has the following: 213,743 active Republican + Conservative Party voters 132,559 active Dem + Working Families Party voters 145,971 active Blank or Independent voters A simple Google search on Independent Voters led me to an organization whose contact information leads us to Shushan, New York, which is in Washington County, and in NY-21. claims to offer a path forward for voters who are frustrated with the traditional Red and Blue parties. It's an attractive idea: avoid partisan politics, choose candidates based on who they are, rather than their party affiliation, and don't play in to the big-machine political parties. But it is killing us in rural districts. With re-districting, my success in getting more voters than any Democrat has ever gotten before in the NY-21 race was matched with a 2.5% drop in margins compared to the guy who ran in the midterms. Clearly we need to turn things around. Volunteer, canvas, phone bank, send postcards. Yes - we need you and we appreciate you. But I need for you to at least consider doing this one step more, and change your voter registration so that you are a registered Democrat. Do ya hear me -- at least consider** it. I'm talking to YOU And definitely, if you are someone who has groused loudly and repeatedly about how the Democratic Party ignores NY-21, I urge you to take care of this voter registration thing right now. It's a risk. You might tell me to go jump. And if you make the decision to maintain your status as an Independent voter, then so be it. But like we say to non-voters, then you lose the license to complain. In this case, you lose the ability to criticize the state Democratic party for failing to put money into races in rural districts. In other words, kindly shut up! (Harsh, I know. My mother would scold me for saying that to somebody.) No political party needs to send money to your congressional district if you can't be bothered to register with that party. This is a big "ask" and I know it I understand that this is a big "ask", and goes against the grain of most North Country thinking. But until we can address the disparity in numbers between the Democratic-leaning voters and the Republican-leaning voters, we will see more results like we have seen since Trump took his famous escalator ride. (We should have known then - it was a down escalator. Pretty symbolic, right?) And it's not just NY-21. Across the country, we need every non-MAGA-aligned voter in these ruby-red counties to consider registering as a Democrat in order for the state and national Democratic Parties to start to make investments for Special Elections in 2025, the mid-terms in 2026, and the General Election in 2028 (which can't get here fast enough!). The Texas House [approved new rules](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu8yAUg5-GbERAaGgGhi5ZfrX6tztGBE6aI0Go4LRp3_4q3e9kS5Y_Wf65TleHEbf7zSWw9F7ypIQ6cSG5MlNwGD-TboKdRRhkA1aazgzGnFTfrLbrB-_0oGQQg-y1MJ0WHmRYzjB3AaBBe8CEVEbKTgnZCnMOpwFmENovsvdMCwhIubS0AsHb1SV-8gtK63Nqol2JHpV1F6ZGpsZ939tUtyNjaoSNPytT4wb7IY8ckdAf9gvia35W4LPbKg-Qsi-OKneVR7hjjY7wBdznlJAIgPvVYTnKrvDLRb7_3f73TbHhsWOMWHvDtLgnh_G7jP686mXVbwAAAP__cS9tRQ) Thursday that prohibit Democrats from holding committee chairmanships. This ends the tradition of the minority party controlling some committees in the state legislature. As a concession, Democrats will be [appointed to all vice chair posts](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGvpCAUBeBfg92dwAVFC4pt7N62WxqEi5JFmQCrb_79ZqZ_9Um-k3P-fC1fNqZ4br_tQaZ9h7wgxx64ANSLtzG9FtV5s3I_iY6M0FJPWvc4dLuZ1KomGqUfZOACsZe6t1yiE-iF99hF88a4QC2ERC4eXI--n2glrlwQg2OKk48tl0fbqdG3rSG98kXl4fLRJbO39qxM_mI4M5zv-37cwdp3yHC2pUWXiOF80l0Zzik7mxjOH4jh7PJZqVy2xYsquBRPt8OWbYIcYM25xXMDT0d2xbYKoeQDEllPpe7xCcWefyvEEz4e7PlffZfhqIErzclJBRSCAuUmD-sqJeDQj6Nwo_Zu6orxzzumFOugmeLbYWP67Go_Hn0Z_B8AAP__t3B_9Q). Republican committee chairs will be required to consult with their Democratic vice chairs to schedule hearings, consider bills, and call witnesses. A draft of the 232-page resolution outlining the new rules was provided to members Thursday morning, and it was put before the body for consideration that afternoon. While some members tried to propose amendments to the rules, State Rep. Jared Patterson (R-Frisco) [used the “nuclear option”](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwjUMoKF7jLq_d0gLuJUYLITJsnPz9Kum3m2JmjnS-LuvFpZxu1_-ukO3PWFcQMHMhOegVXcqvVQ1ovUAjB7JST9poPcNp2OwkMIDH6LWbEL0UZlbOeGNCdOjVeUj2fSYkaCknEHIU-oyzIU9ChShPgSlBmHrdx75Rp6drMb_qg_Yx1DJku_V-b2z6x2BhsBzHMcb6VDc62rvAYHlHBstnyrf604j7XMN340ilht31xuNeC8_kMN2uPNRSUu9Ebdgt3o-Uc2onzZS4Fpfyh9v_FPGw8BsAAP__uApjcw) by moving to end debate and vote on the measure. The rules were approved by a vote of 116-23, with only one Democrat opposing the resolution. The new rules consolidate several standing committees and [create a new Delivery of Government Efficiency (DOGE) committee](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j72O6yAQRp8GOiwY_xAKitu4y223tLAZYiRiLA8Oztuvkn777ztH5-c-3V1McXv8d0-05Qp5Agm9kEqAnryL6T113NtZeqM4WqVbbbTuYeCrDQDetGHWPRhpsJ09dG5w6uZn7d2geLQfmFSglWpBqkbqm-8Nzii7JahhYZ1EH0s-mrJiwctRSO_8wqNZ8pMnu5ayE2v_MRgZjLXWJuRLu5NK3D4TBuOGlRiM37NY80koVkdiwyqOMyGJPbkFBSFRzBs_rN9rTCnSoFknH08X01dW_qx_WfgNAAD__7aCXkk) in an apparent move to mimic President Trump’s cost-cutting initiative at the federal level.
## DFW Passes Austin for Highest Rent
Austin is no longer the most expensive rental market in Texas, having recently [ceded that status to Dallas-Fort Worth](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z72O6yAUBOCngc7W4QDGKShu4y633dIicGyQ8I8wiZO3Xzn9diON9I3m5z7eXcppnf-7hWx9T9uIgLoB0aAZg0v5Myoe7APCTXCywkhzM0Zjx6PV5gEBe20wSHJOC-n6rlMe5DRRT4Ene2Eg0AghEUQLpg_6Rg8C5SfReaaAQqpbaWukSm93TPmzvai0flt4trHW_WDyH8OB4XCeZ-tj2darZTj4Z67PQgwHV2ry-UoxzZGO2hRaa_MVGwTQSvei3ePOiw37mXJOR2eYgnlxKX_H6p_vXxZ_AwAA__8zilxk). According to data from real estate firms like Zillow, the average rent in DFW last month was $1,532, while Austin’s was $1,512. Several recent indicators point to a slowdown in growth in the state’s capital, which has had the highest rents in Texas since 2015. Between July 2022 and July 2023, more people moved out of Austin's Travis County than moved in for the first time in 20 years. ## Pig Organ Transplant Facility Coming to Houston
United Therapeutics Corp., a biotechnology company that supplies animal-based organs for transplantation in humans, plans to build a $96 million facility in Houston to [house up to 200 genetically modified pigs](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3TnCAQxz8NduvA6olXUKSxe9KmdBBW3XkQHCDn3bfPmEmb7lfs_t9-fc1flgPH7ac9yNT3mmaU-ACpAPXsLYfP3DfeLNI_VUNG6U4_tX7g0OzGK-oIl04Obuw7J1f0KAc1jLIbcBzHhs0tJhVqpTqUqpV69I8nLSR7t6rBiV6S55pyW3eq9LZlDZ_0oty6dDTB7LWeRXQ_BE4Cp-u6WhfYfeOefpea4n0lcIp0FYFTSM4GgdPtKXCS6uabFk6V3A4r5wPOYGOBmiBbLgQbRarsbAgfOJLnlcnDyVuBNWVIebMRarax3H-1QCSbIdhvgn8ZBE5NNv68OAQugxa93A7L4W-D-t9JXwb_BAAA__86Dnn5). A company representative described the pigs as "gene-edited organisms.” They will be used for xenotransplantation, the process of transplanting non-human organs into humans. The pigs will be fed a vegetarian diet, and their living conditions must be certified by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. In November, a 53-year-old Alabama woman received a United-supplied pig kidney (called a UKidney) with 10 gene edits. Now the [longest-living recipient of a pig organ transplant](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb8Gd1gw2JlQULzGXV67pYUBGyQCFp7Eyd-vkn7rq3t0dH5u882mnMr2396DoddaZxAwciE54Oxtyu956LxZhNeyC0aiQo04wqWLRq52cQ6vCyq9-DBIpxWOAr2S2jnALpkPTEhAKRUI2Qu8-lGHJYjBrfLi2CCCT1RbTzFQeNljze_6DK139d5lE4n2g6l_DCYG03mevYutls_KYCrhPBhMsT4OqoV__wwm2yi5HBhMS6oUXOR72nhtmy2cmi3Hnm0h_iiJgucgxIhSq36Pe9eM38-UczouyAax3W3KXxX6s83TwG8AAAD__019Z7c), Towana Looney recently told reporters she felt like “superwoman.” Construction on the 77,448-square-foot facility is expected to begin in February and to be completed next summer.

## Trump Tariffs Turn Colombia Around
The White House said Sunday night that Colombia had [backed down in its fight](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDuO4zAQRE8jZTT4EdlWwGATZ950Q4FiN6VeUKJA0TZ8-4Fn4smqUEDh4f27T_fAmfflb9jIt1QmLbUVUgkNEwbO72no0SciTaYnr8DACAAO-tW7EeMMozRziqAhxTFoE1FRVAhaYs_-8yaVBqWMk-oyOzQmJIsWrB0ddYMk5Fbq5X_hva2U8rs8qV5i2frs19aOszN_On3r9C0cO73Oz_QptXHM1OlbLLlsMwfB28ZLDY3LLpCOUttPTpmXtZ3ioFaLaPWxHeJxCgdXkDQoa120eIVRodYUHTiQw5iwrx6PF-fMp4NukMsWOH-Dtd9EPb3-CgAA__9_lmrb) with President Donald Trump over allowing U.S. military flights to return illegal immigrants to that country. The turnaround came hours after Trump announced he was imposing a 25% tariff on Colombian goods and a travel ban on its officials due to Colombian President Gustavo Petro [rejecting two deportation flights](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L3u4yAQBPCngY6ID8MmBcU17nLtlRY2S9gTGAtzifL2p6T_1zP6jTR_7ss9UKH98TtU9CO1RUtthVRCwxIDlfcy8egTokbD0SswcAMABzz7TdpkJnvdVrhKK10yYVqNlQ6DiVoBJ__RpNKglHFSXVYXjQnJRgvW3hyySWKk0frlb6N9ZEzl3Z7YL1urvPg8xnEy84vpmel5ZMxUyidjes6t4o6vk-k5xEo7naOHQW1nerZKggMjRv9XDzFCp5ROsbXS6kpBRDxaH9-ySIUeeXwU3n08XlQKnQ7YJB810HeMj5-OeXr9PwAA__8PNmYT) from the U.S. and refusing to accept others. White House officials held up the episode as a warning to other nations, and said the tariffs would be held in reserve but not signed if the flights resumed. "_The government of Colombia has agreed to all of President Trump 's terms, including the unrestricted acceptance of all illegal aliens from Colombia returned from the United States, including on U.S. military aircraft, without limitation or delay,_" said White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt.
## CIA: COVID Likely from Chinese Lab
The CIA says it now believes that COVID-19 likely originated from a [laboratory leak in China](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uwyAUxfGngY2Ib5yBoVLlLV07WsRcwq0wWBglyttX7t75SL8j_b9vyy1gwfr4Chv4kdoiuTSMCybdEgOW96Jp9AlAgqLghVPu6pyzjmbvjOZWBm7XSYCNctLa8Emsk7A6xSlQ9KfGhXRCKMvF5W6jUiGZaJwxVwtEc4g4Wr_8NKwjQyrv9oR-WdtGi89j7AdRH0TORM4jQ8ZSzo3IObcNKrwOIucQN6x4jB4GtkrkbAR33Ai2YmBHxjQONjK0_matsrU9MbLW8YGVddhbHydC1DzuHRJRn3mn3cf9haXgYR3R_LEF_Dum479ITy9_AwAA__9kJGkQ), shifting from previous neutral statements about the virus’ origins. The shift comes just a few days after John Ratcliffe was sworn in as the agency’s new director and as the CIA released a Biden-initiated report on Saturday. name: History Facts
subject: The Rockies used to have a different name ⛰️
body:
The Rocky Mountains have had many names since humans first came into contact with them, some more fanciful than others. [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68d83f6j6wyu1n2qbp4d2l0xzdh9211parr8j3mupugg7g7bk4gsydr5huzptvskzxuplxudkh94da24fw0bia62cvnbpueh36v5fy2q7mw6j8tvnwodhf5ygb1sje05exoiy15ydwof6o197&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [The Rocky Mountains were once called the Stony Mountains.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T he Rocky Mountains have had many names since humans first came into contact with them, some more fanciful than others. Their current moniker comes from the Plains Cree term ᐊᓯᓃᐘᒋᐩ, usually transcribed as _asinîwaciy_ and literally meaning “rocky mountain” or “alp.” The first European to describe the pride of Colorado was explorer Jacques Legardeur de Saint-Pierre, who [gave](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) them their current name when he called the mountains “montagnes de Roche” in a 1752 journal entry. Four decades later, the John Reid Company published a [map](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) in which they were called the [Stony Mountains](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com).
---
[Another journal](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), this one belonging to fur trader Gabriel Franchere and written between 1811 and 1814, claimed “the first travellers called them the ‘Glittering Mountains,’ on account of the infinite number of immense rock crystals, which, they say, cover their surface, and ... reflect to an immense distance the rays of sun.” The Rockies have also been called the Mountains of Bright Stones and the Shining Mountains, each name a testament to how striking they are.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## The Andes are the longest mountain range in the world.
The Rockies are massive, passing through six U.S. states (Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Utah, Colorado, and New Mexico) in addition to two Canadian provinces (Alberta and British Columbia), but they aren’t the longest above-water mountain range in the world. That would be the Andes, which are [5,500 miles long](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqqxoo&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) — 2,500 miles longer than the Rockies. (The longest mountain range of any kind is the mid-ocean ridge.) The Andes extend across the entire western edge of South America, passing through Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela on their way to the Caribbean. Aconcagua, a mountain in Argentina, is the range’s peak at an elevation of 22,831 feet. The world’s highest volcanoes are also in the Andes, including the 22,615-foot-tall (and, thankfully, dormant) Ojos del Salado.

clean_body: The Rocky Mountains have had many names since humans first came into contact with them, some more fanciful than others. | T he Rocky Mountains have had many names since humans first came into contact with them, some more fanciful than others. Their current moniker comes from the Plains Cree term ᐊᓯᓃᐘᒋᐩ, usually transcribed as asinîwaciy and literally meaning “rocky mountain” or “alp.” The first European to describe the pride of Colorado was explorer Jacques Legardeur de Saint-Pierre, who them their current name when he called the mountains “montagnes de Roche” in a 1752 journal entry. Four decades later, the John Reid Company published a in which they were called the . , this one belonging to fur trader Gabriel Franchere and written between 1811 and 1814, claimed “the first travellers called them the ‘Glittering Mountains,’ on account of the infinite number of immense rock crystals, which, they say, cover their surface, and ... reflect to an immense distance the rays of sun.” The Rockies have also been called the Mountains of Bright Stones and the Shining Mountains, each name a testament to how striking they are. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Length (in miles) of the Rocky Mountains 3,000 | | Elevation (in feet) of Mount Elbert, the Rockies’ peak 14,439 | Elevation (in feet) of Mount Elbert, the Rockies’ peak 14,439 | | MLB World Series won by the Colorado Rockies 0 | | Main groupings of the Rockies (Northern/Canadian, Middle, Wyoming Basin, and Southern) 4 | Main groupings of the Rockies (Northern/Canadian, Middle, Wyoming Basin, and Southern) 4 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- The Andes are the longest mountain range in the world. The Rockies are massive, passing through six U.S. states (Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Utah, Colorado, and New Mexico) in addition to two Canadian provinces (Alberta and British Columbia), but they aren’t the longest above-water mountain range in the world. That would be the Andes, which are — 2,500 miles longer than the Rockies. (The longest mountain range of any kind is the mid-ocean ridge.) The Andes extend across the entire western edge of South America, passing through Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela on their way to the Caribbean. Aconcagua, a mountain in Argentina, is the range’s peak at an elevation of 22,831 feet. The world’s highest volcanoes are also in the Andes, including the 22,615-foot-tall (and, thankfully, dormant) Ojos del Salado. “It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=e859fde881d04dc3abbc2c29c0865e91&_e=w1VQGkkpQDONTVP4I9HYBlR4M_zRlvjZ4HrUSd4TQ4jIHoSvQdkSr8S1ciKEVPtYYAbbmGF7yAX4u8M5h5eM7yWPMuTnsEc8PUD_qagZAngd-BqQ2MiHRK8ZcfhKfeXBfA0Xeqa3SkQydhPkM8QocCxbXiZPTHWTrAKfVhqjJnHlrPCIkkePVRjjESKNHdihF0mQ17lJT-Vyz261kWK6zSCmW1Qc8i-lteIrLSex6VheuPLQ02ejWc0LFODafZkxrfFlwNSBgWcIbsdUVzlk2Z4ef9Kvvt1U2cSx8uOjOHaXdUPmr8AcV74zKT4Ph7x-TzVOF5szY3cvv7tZjfkNIuMrYqEdhwMtIVrb1Rq4uYiStYhW42smleCo4j9CbBEsWjs31KyvSupEeq5G2YIIACp0EyAslpEiMPW_ZhSHCUlpjN9kknssPQ3CUWsT04s9cA7AgrVI2h73BC_Pyy2Now%3D%3D) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. # Tax belongs in commerce, NOT assessed annually against your owned property at the point of forfeiture in the courts.
It is not in ANY way Constitutional to tax a citizen annually for the right to own the assets for which they already have purchased and paid tax. ALL tax belongs in commerce. ALL OF IT. So...how did the entire tax burden of the state and nation end up on the homeowners, wage owners and small business? Lobbyists. That's how. Big Corps hired lobbyists to lobby and buy off your elected officials to put the entire tax burden on the wage earning, home owners and small business owners. Big Corps pay almost NO property tax and little income tax. In fact, they lobbied YOUR elected officials to FUND LOBBYISTS with YOUR TAX DOLLARS to then lobby your elected officials to RAISE YOUR TAXES. Are you sick of this yet? I bet you are and so are we. We can only fix this if we work together. That is why we started BIZPAC.us 7 years ago and you should be a part of it. I invite you to join us Thursday February 13th for a BIZPAC Roundtable Luncheon you will not forget. Learn what we are doing to stop this madness in Texas and more here: **https://gem.godaddy.com/p/ec1ccb1** Sincerely, JL Trahan
BIZPAC.us Founder and Executive Chairman

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z272sldnriikjde7vij4l8jsl4ap2v1b3cnph428_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s1g6ep34c9h2bs) [NO](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7elm62lre7tsktbe8okriunh8hg3vfo4noq6b00_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s1g6ep34c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zabj5lqsmhqeqjramaeh458m0po0iesnr2jhu04g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s1g6ep34c9h2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Byron Donalds **[sparred with News Nation host Chris Cuomo](https://substack.com/redirect/3ac9cd54-fac5-4395-bedc-6a40a2924844?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over forced Diversity, Equity and Inclusion quotas in the job market and the government that he says have brought down performance standards across the board.
The debate was sparked by Trump's executive order to close DEI offices across the federal government, leaving hundreds of federal workers jobless.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3ac9cd54-fac5-4395-bedc-6a40a2924844?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"If DEI isn't forced as a focus, you will not have inclusion of minorities, regardless of foundation of merit, and that's why it needs to be a point of emphasis," Cuomo prompted Donalds.
"We've had diversity ideas, not just in the federal government, but in the private sector for decades," Donalds said. "The 'equity' piece that was really introduced in the Biden-Harris administration at the federal level is the one that is the cause for concern because it ignores merit!"
"At the end of the day, everybody wants to make sure that people who are getting jobs are qualified to do them..." he added. **[Watch the debate below:](https://substack.com/redirect/3ac9cd54-fac5-4395-bedc-6a40a2924844?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

The move also led to the cancellation of around $420 million in DEI-related contracts. The Department of Government Efficiency, under Elon Musk's leadership, announced these actions on X.
The order, signed on Trump's inauguration day, mandates the closure of all DEI offices by the end of Wednesday, with workers in those roles being put on immediate paid leave. The Office of Personnel Management directed agencies to remove DEI-related websites, cancel training sessions, and terminate contracts.

| | It’s important you download your concealed carry certificate before it's banned for good.

Due to increased pressure from lawmakers, a website offering you a certificate for America’s Top CCW Gun Permit **could be shut down at any moment.**

Which is why it’s important you download your **Concealed Carry Certificate ASAP**.

Wait even one more day and we won’t be able to guarantee this certificate will be available to download.

This certificate is great for gun owners because it takes advantage of a little-known (but 100% legal) loophole - **[allowing you to get a CCW certification from this website](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/20039/6374453/5a56ef1b8c5734126a6fb182ea7635faa3c09a06/afd4da11260f5654ee3a353cd2e0376b6e0cc9a2). You don’t even have to leave your house to do it!**

This loophole ensures you encounter:
* Zero government red tape (and no exposing your private info to the Feds)...
* Zero lines, classroom time or books to read...
* Zero gun range time (you don’t even need to fire a gun to get this permit).

**[It’s as simple as visiting this site and answering a few questions (they’re simple)](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/20039/6374453/5a56ef1b8c5734126a6fb182ea7635faa3c09a06/afd4da11260f5654ee3a353cd2e0376b6e0cc9a2).**

Plus you can complete the entire certification process online.

Download it directly to your phone or computer in as little as 30 minutes.

**You don’t even need to own a gun to get this permit...** that’s why it’s named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Permit.

31 states have agreed to accept this permit so far. That’s because it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized permit that’s available right now.

This permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry permit either. **It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.**

**Hurry and get it now.**

**[There are no guarantees this website](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/20039/6374453/5a56ef1b8c5734126a6fb182ea7635faa3c09a06/afd4da11260f5654ee3a353cd2e0376b6e0cc9a2)** will be able to legally deliver this certificate to your email address after today!

name: Jeff Jackson
subject: Hello as your new AG
body:
There's so much to tell you

| |
---|---|---
|
# Hello as your new AG
### There's so much to tell you
| | | [Jeff Jackson](https://substack.com/@jeffjacksonnc)
---
| Jan 27
---
| [](https://substack.com/@jeffjacksonnc)
---
The last time you heard from me, I was a member of Congress. It was just before Christmas.
A few days later, I resigned.
Why? Because my congressional term was set to end on January 3rd, but my Attorney General term was set to begin on January 1st. So to avoid an overlap, I resigned from Congress a few days early.
On New Year's Day, I took the oath in the county courthouse. It was just our family, Judge Cureton, and a state employee who brought the "oath book," which apparently you have to sign upon taking office.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d4d0d4c8-ab1f-4ed4-9e4b-0da3e61f4959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That night, during dinner, Owen asked if he could come with me for my first day at the office. I was a little surprised that he wanted to come, but I thought it'd be great. So we got to the NCDOJ building early the next morning, stood in the lobby, and together we greeted my new colleagues as they arrived.
Then we walked into my new office and Owen made himself at home:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f3c57f5a-f694-4718-baa9-aa6003c7f424?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **Blitzing the learning curve**
Here's a quick overview of what it means to be AG in our state:
* The AG runs the NC Department of Justice, which has about 1,000 employees. About one-third are attorneys, which makes us the largest law firm in the state.
* Apart from special circumstances, we generally don't handle front-line prosecutions, but we do handle criminal appeals. So once someone is convicted and they say, "I appeal," we handle the case.
* We defend the state when it gets sued, but we also sue _on behalf_ of the state. For example, if someone slips and falls on state property and sues the state, we would defend the state. But, on the other hand, if someone pollutes the water, contributes to an opioid epidemic, breaks its contract with the state, engages in price fixing for generic drugs, facilitates illegal mass robocalls into our state, engages in monopolistic behavior when selling tickets to major entertainment events, or uses artificial intelligence to unlawfully raise people's rents (more on that below...), then we sue them. In many cases, we join with other states and make it a multi-state effort.
* The NCDOJ also includes the state crime lab (three buildings across the state), the main training center for law enforcement officers in the state (two campuses), and the training and standards commissions for police officers and sheriffs.

All of which means that I've got a steep learning curve. To address it, I've packed my schedule with everything I need to get up to speed: meeting with all the sections at NCDOJ, doing deep dives into ongoing litigation, and traveling the state to hear from as many people as possible. I'm basically trying to blitz the learning curve, and the reason I can do it is because I've got a great team around me that's willing to help.
### **First major action**
Here's the short version:
There's a company that sells a piece of software that uses artificial intelligence and private data from major landlords to tell those landlords what rents they should charge.
It's called RealPage and it essentially tells major landlords, "Sign up with us, give us your private data every day about rental rates, occupancy, and trends, and we'll tell _all of you_ what rents you should charge."
According to RealPage, the whole idea is about "driving every possible opportunity to increase price" and "avoid[ing] the race to the bottom in down markets."
In other words, to replace competition with collusion.
One of their executives said that, "there is greater good in everybody succeeding versus essentially trying to compete against one another in a way that actually keeps the entire industry down." Another said that this could help landlords to "have a $50 increase instead of a $10 increase for the day."
And landlords responded. One of them said, "I always liked this product because your algorithm uses proprietary data from other subscribers to suggest rents and term. That's classic price fixing..."
RealPage itself has already been sued by NCDOJ and many other states. My first major action was to expand that lawsuit to also include six mega-landlords who, we believe, used this software to unlawfully collude with each other to raise rents.
From the evidence, it appears North Carolina is the _most impacted state in the country_ by the use of this software. So far, we estimate it applied to over 70,000 rental units across the state, with a very heavy presence in Charlotte metro and Research Triangle regions.
Basically, if a bunch of landlords met in a back room and said, "Let's share data and raise our rents together," that would be illegal. We're saying that they were using a piece of software that was built to accomplish essentially the same effect, and North Carolinians suffered higher rents as a result.
### **Going forward**
Many of you have asked that I continue sending email updates as AG like I did in Congress.
Got it - will do. But I'll only email you when I have something meaningful to share. That means it won't be on a set schedule; it'll happen organically.
I'm really looking forward to bringing a higher degree of transparency to this position, and I think you'll find it pretty interesting.
Best,
Jeff

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Never expected this.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I never would have thought that the people who stormed the Capitol on January 6th, who violently assaulted police officers, would go free two years later.
#

Peter,
While I was on patrol as a Marine in Iraq, while my brothers and I were in combat, while my friends were being wounded and killed... I never would’ve expected that nearly 20 years later I’d have to be ready to fight to defend our democracy on the floor of the House of Representatives.
And as I stood on the House floor on January 6th, teaching my colleagues how to use gas masks, texting my staff on where to hide and how to keep safe, getting ready to defend myself... I never would have thought that the people who stormed the Capitol that day, who violently assaulted police officers, would go free two years later.
But on his first day in office, President Trump pardoned and commuted sentences for every single one of the January 6th rioters. We’re talking about people who came in with guns, zip ties, people who beat cops and left them battered and bleeding.
It’s a gross misuse of power, and I understand if it’s left you worried about what comes next.
Here’s something I believe, though: This country is stronger than the actions of any one person, even the president. And if we stick together, we’ll make it through this.
I’ve always been lucky to have friends, family, and a community that had my back. I would not have been able to build a life for myself without them. I would not have gotten into Harvard, or survived Iraq without them.
I am serving in the United States Senate to deliver for them — and for you.

We’ve got a lot of work to do to fight back, and donations like this are how we keep up the pressure.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-jan25.N6iRGd&refcode=em250127-1-90&t=1&akid=3674%2E734936%2Eauf8Vo)

US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents knock on the door of a residence in Chicago, Illinois, during Sunday’s raids. (Photographer: Christopher Dilts/Bloomberg)
By Illinois Review

On Sunday, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), in collaboration with various federal agencies including the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives, the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and the U.S. Marshals descended on Chicago to carry out “targeted operations” to root out and arrest dangerous migrants who were here illegally and taking advantage of the city’s “sanctuary city” status.

President Donald Trump’s “Border Czar” Tom Homan and Acting U.S. Deputy Attorney General Emil Bove were also spotted in Chicago early Sunday – as well as television personality and psychologist Dr. Phil McGraw – who was documenting the raids as an outside observer.

On Saturday evening, Dr. Phil went on X and revealed that we would be “embedded” with Homan to witness the ICE operation in Chicago on Sunday – noting it was a “high risk mission.” McGraw also wanted to set the record straight about the raids.

“This truly is a targeted ICE mission because they are not sweeping neighborhoods like people are trying to imply.”

The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress, friend: Minnesota joined the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact and Maine's state legislature is working to join as well.
If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 17 states plus DC have now joined.
Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and totaling 78% of what is needed to make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress.
Whether it's through the NPVIC or one of the other legal alternatives, ending the Electoral College forever is a big priority.

If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 17 states plus DC have now joined. Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and totaling 78% of what is needed to make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress. And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6615b717ebe4470f9fddba42ce1fad78&_e=VAledooi123VYtakUIybWkZTbD-MjQtEktqwIlZV3BJH6I3ccVcr2RdwijrpaUqna4UPrx3aBaclwV7iTjLJkk0JINQbr21rUSHiPjl4JTcuh7UDB_1FSY-_GJtsj3n7VJkshdsyvx8fv0Axb57aZLw6lH9lAq3khc-FeIDMxN5phbJngxgBs21sfUDVi-W0BkhYu5jDRz1zQSN11Hl4U2oUIK9lNUjF5Y9FabYOO7jOLS924qsqgIUSCRoBYqZn8KM4ZedcZ97XUAj3c2QzFLq8Frt8-hSolXAY2xYdPwthhm7bdWzdu4yejPCuuTETgMcO0aJHQMkxk9fbcTJr_GwQioqhduYoZ5nWlmRTdUf1XOI_Az3mJePsBI8a4zHCANyoBQrPNCLjI1Oov6A3IsyoAhe9c65UznBiez6gFy0UYC0eFhKcr_JLiTwCDwPXtXyjNCmY1qE3nv0D1wbtww%3D%3D)'s IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[ Check if you qualify ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6615b717ebe4470f9fddba42ce1fad78&_e=VAledooi123VYtakUIybWkZTbD-MjQtEktqwIlZV3BJH6I3ccVcr2RdwijrpaUqna4UPrx3aBaclwV7iTjLJkk0JINQbr21rUSHiPjl4JTcuh7UDB_1FSY-_GJtsj3n7VJkshdsyvx8fv0Axb57aZLw6lH9lAq3khc-FeIDMxN5phbJngxgBs21sfUDVi-W0BkhYu5jDRz1zQSN11Hl4U2oUIK9lNUjF5Y9FabYOO7jOLS924qsqgIUSCRoBYqZn8KM4ZedcZ97XUAj3c2QzFLq8Frt8-hSolXAY2xYdPwthhm7bdWzdu4yejPCuuTET0fZ26jJ6gxYh64JTEPVR2Hj3QlmpMXAvb7aJ-WaO8bQl2RHd99Pv4NVcaYKQISM1rlH5CcYBhi3zYsBiXg5uGjKNCAJxFacbmzmXPK-7nce9vT70E9uLl1dRI7lj2IH0bvf_baZrLC98dZq-4FUlIw%3D%3D)
[ ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6615b717ebe4470f9fddba42ce1fad78&_e=VAledooi123VYtakUIybWkZTbD-MjQtEktqwIlZV3BJH6I3ccVcr2RdwijrpaUqna4UPrx3aBaclwV7iTjLJkk0JINQbr21rUSHiPjl4JTcuh7UDB_1FSY-_GJtsj3n7VJkshdsyvx8fv0Axb57aZLw6lH9lAq3khc-FeIDMxN5phbJngxgBs21sfUDVi-W0BkhYu5jDRz1zQSN11Hl4U2oUIK9lNUjF5Y9FabYOO7jOLS924qsqgIUSCRoBYqZn8KM4ZedcZ97XUAj3c2QzFLq8Frt8-hSolXAY2xYdPwthhm7bdWzdu4yejPCuuTETKGm4sLxA7-36qBAbCSzlWZWzBcGlZVF2DPhwX7mEiiIYbb8W6Xs6-FFDSvPig-xl5RnLCSTu0-TYm7EWDIMfe1_yumSzYZyHK7h3toVYeaZ80bnH5e182ufny_wT_SrLskxWS5b-orVoqDD7w87u4Q%3D%3D)
What makes [hear.com](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6615b717ebe4470f9fddba42ce1fad78&_e=VAledooi123VYtakUIybWkZTbD-MjQtEktqwIlZV3BJH6I3ccVcr2RdwijrpaUqna4UPrx3aBaclwV7iTjLJkk0JINQbr21rUSHiPjl4JTcuh7UDB_1FSY-_GJtsj3n7VJkshdsyvx8fv0Axb57aZLw6lH9lAq3khc-FeIDMxN5phbJngxgBs21sfUDVi-W0BkhYu5jDRz1zQSN11Hl4U2oUIK9lNUjF5Y9FabYOO7jOLS924qsqgIUSCRoBYqZn8KM4ZedcZ97XUAj3c2QzFLq8Frt8-hSolXAY2xYdPwthhm7bdWzdu4yejPCuuTETZh_ZYs4Z_rH3SZfdeVpd61PUC5zX7bGYWt39jozVtDT0qjm8o1ALCb4FVoPPEIuqqW2VjluhqwIIY-p7l14JfqinmlkUBjeevCCQpUcTJY2vPrBifnzn1JHXaOJc-7FTCtHgcYnBLAy05cfVNn7dww%3D%3D)’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6615b717ebe4470f9fddba42ce1fad78&_e=VAledooi123VYtakUIybWkZTbD-MjQtEktqwIlZV3BJH6I3ccVcr2RdwijrpaUqna4UPrx3aBaclwV7iTjLJkk0JINQbr21rUSHiPjl4JTcuh7UDB_1FSY-_GJtsj3n7VJkshdsyvx8fv0Axb57aZLw6lH9lAq3khc-FeIDMxN5phbJngxgBs21sfUDVi-W0BkhYu5jDRz1zQSN11Hl4U2oUIK9lNUjF5Y9FabYOO7jOLS924qsqgIUSCRoBYqZn8KM4ZedcZ97XUAj3c2QzFLq8Frt8-hSolXAY2xYdPwthhm7bdWzdu4yejPCuuTET6i0VlUL5f_1O_cffieqjoAz7shgY79D6m0wsC1Gxqm51t7cNtvnspcfSd3QlL2oE383X0QvGacXOx-9pn3d0kXJryCRqR8AF4G64CyrpfZ15NilS0LqSaTyvxbUgjkGzOChe-WiwHyUfrbVD4X5-MA%3D%3D)’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=6615b717ebe4470f9fddba42ce1fad78&_e=VAledooi123VYtakUIybWkZTbD-MjQtEktqwIlZV3BJH6I3ccVcr2RdwijrpaUqna4UPrx3aBaclwV7iTjLJkk0JINQbr21rUSHiPjl4JTcuh7UDB_1FSY-_GJtsj3n7VJkshdsyvx8fv0Axb57aZLw6lH9lAq3khc-FeIDMxN5phbJngxgBs21sfUDVi-W0BkhYu5jDRz1zQSN11Hl4U2oUIK9lNUjF5Y9FabYOO7jOLS924qsqgIUSCRoBYqZn8KM4ZedcZ97XUAj3c2QzFLq8Frt8-hSolXAY2xYdPwthhm7bdWzdu4yejPCuuTETOmkG5fSdJ1WJ0DfVtRP_LZCFIIXZf7tPMsBenTdowJip42emuqtF-zPF2NLYSQOnysgcsvm5V_h3x7WNEnHEBfDfl4Nr4i4jB3y1dQ3wCvyJJhj0GozEomUT62F5GGg-_2hQNCVm6cFSreRqqaIScg%3D%3D) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

| | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away. And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate... ...to Jesus. And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood... ...by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love. Here’s exactly what their strategy is... First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic. In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin. Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible. clean_body: | Hey team — We've been getting messages from people all over the country wondering how we keep up the fight for our democracy now that Trump's back in power. Before we answer them, we want to remind you of something very important: Trump's strategy right now is to overwhelm us. He and his MAGA followers want us to exhaust ourselves responding to every ridiculous thing he does. This fight for our future is a MARATHON, not a sprint. If we're going to fight back against his agenda for the next four years, we can't let them overwhelm us. | Now, let’s address some of your concerns: How much can we really do when Republicans control the White House, the Senate, and the House of Representatives? We won’t lie to you: The road ahead is going to be challenging. And the likelihood of being able to stop everything Trump and his MAGA cronies try to push through Congress isn't high. But that doesn’t mean Trump gets a free pass to do whatever he wants. Republicans’ majorities in the House and Senate are slim. And not every Republican has been willing to bow down to Trump’s demands. So what do we do? We keep applying pressure! It's up to us to let our elected officials know what we won't tolerate. And trust us when we say, members of Congress care way more about getting reelected than about pleasing a president in his final term of office. What about the Supreme Court? It’s true — the far-right majority on the Supreme Court has cost us student loan relief, abortion access, affirmative action, and much more. So we’re going to apply pressure on Congress to hold the Court accountable. Passing judicial reform measurements like the TERM Act will be critical in our fight against Trump and his MAGA allies. But we’re up against powerful people with so much money! Yes. And? Look, we know it’s scary. Elon Musk alone spent at least $133 million bankrolling Trump’s campaign. The inauguration was a who's who of billionaires kissing Trump's ass. They've made it clear that they’re only interested in their bottom line. But when we stand up, work together, and reject the status quo, we make progress a reality. So we’re keeping up the fight for corporate accountability and demanding that the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share. What can I do right now to help keep up the fight against Trump’s agenda? | Together, NextGen America | | = |

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis**
---
---
**This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_“Food shortages are coming.”_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life – depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20045/6374453/654bd59d568f35638cbbb85924c1427f1daa3ea7/246344d91dc9fe1b330da7bf2fbd7227531aacd0). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20045/6374453/654bd59d568f35638cbbb85924c1427f1daa3ea7/246344d91dc9fe1b330da7bf2fbd7227531aacd0) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. [**Stock up now**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20045/6374453/654bd59d568f35638cbbb85924c1427f1daa3ea7/246344d91dc9fe1b330da7bf2fbd7227531aacd0) on these survival food kits while you can. **More Raving Customer Reviews!** **Rory H.**
"I was surprised to find that the densely packed packages were easy to prepare and were tasty as well. I definitely recommend having survival food on hand for the times when 'life' happens while we are planning other things." **Billy H.**

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: This revival mission needs you!
body:
| | | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away.And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate......to Jesus.And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood......by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love.Here’s exactly what their strategy is...First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. EBENSBURG, PA. When Nicholas Bentivegna and his wife, Teresa, purchased a fixer-upper cabin in Hampton Township, Allegheny County, in October 2020, they had no idea they would find themselves in the middle of a controversy that has roiled Pittsburgh politics for decades.
Shortly after their purchase, the Bentivegnas were hit with a lawsuit from the Hampton Township School District, seeking to increase the tax assessment on the cabin. Mr. Bentivegna, a lawyer in Cambria County, has been a municipal solicitor for some 30 years. "I had never heard of such a law," he muses. "So, I looked it up on my phone." His immediate reaction? "It's unconstitutional. Most definitely."
The Bentivegnas soon learned that their case was one of hundreds filed by the Hampton School District over the years, and thousands routinely filed by other districts within Allegheny County. "It's a pretty well-oiled machine," Mr. Bentivegna explains. "School district assessment appeals are initially heard by the Board of Property Assessment Appeals and Review, or BPAAR, an agency of Allegheny County. The BPAAR hearings were originally designed as an informal process, to be used by taxpayers seeking a reduction in their assessment, if their property had declined in value." He continues, "There was no need to hire a lawyer or an appraiser, or to follow formal rules of evidence. You simply went in and told your story."
Mr. Bentivegna feels the process is being abused by the school districts. "They use specialized legal counsel, funded by tax dollars, who essentially act as criminal prosecutors. "Unlike real criminals though," Mr. Bentivegna says, "you are guilty until proven innocent. The lawyers pull a few comps off the internet, nobody testifies, and the BPAAR rubber-stamps the tax increase. My hearing took eight minutes, over the phone. The retroactive tax increase came in the mail a few days later."
The next level in the appeals process is the "Board of Viewers," a creation of the Allegheny County Court of Common Pleas. The Bentivegnas promptly filed an appeal, but with a twist: They added a count asserting that the enabling statute was unconstitutional. "The Board's rules place an emphasis on conciliation, so I thought I might get a better deal," Mr. Bentivegna says.
It didn't quite work out that way. "You either accept what the school district offers you or you don't," Mr. Bentivegna observes. "The Board of Viewers delays action on your case until you accept the school district's terms. They stalled for over a year, and never did schedule an actual hearing. In the final analysis, the Board of Viewers is kind of like the Sasquatch. There may be some grainy photos, but there is no real proof that it actually exists."
The Bentivegnas' next filed a Motion in the Court of Common Pleas, seeking to proceed directly on the constitutional issue. This was heard before the Honorable Alan Hertzberg. "Judge Hertzberg turned out to be very fair-minded," Mr. Bentivegna says. "He was willing to allow me to present my case, which is all I asked for." "Look," he continues, "I get that filing a constitutional challenge to a tax law is a good way to get labeled as some sort of a nut case. But it doesn't mean I'm wrong."
According to Mr. Bentivegna, the enabling statute for the tax assessment lawsuit fails on three constitutional grounds. It extends reciprocal constitutional rights to the government that are reserved to citizens alone. It violates due process, particularly in terms of "vagueness," in that citizens do not know what the law expects of them. And, it violates equal protection, in that it forces selected citizens to have their property assessments set through litigation, as opposed to a regular administrative process. "The individual lawsuits set the property values as of the date of the hearing, where the last countywide assessment on neighboring properties was performed in 2012," Mr. Bentivegna explains. "Because outdated assessments are artificially low, municipalities compensate by setting millage rates that are artificially high. So, when school districts file these lawsuits, they basically double dip. For the individual property owner, the tax increase is massive."
"But really," Mr. Bentivegna observes, "It's just a matter of common sense. Our country has what I would call a constitutional culture. People instinctively know when their rights are being violated. No one who is hit with one of these lawsuits feels he or she is being treated fairly." "Moreover," he contends, "the current system doesn't benefit anyone but the lawyers. They're like a pack of wolves." Mr. Bentivegna feels that a properly designed property tax collection system, that is, with regular countywide assessments, would ultimately secure enhanced revenue for the public schools, at a lower aggregate cost to the taxpayers. "You'd simply cut out all the middlemen," he says, "Hey, it works pretty well in 49 other states."
As it turned out, the Bentivegnas' opportunity to present their case in court was rather short-lived. The Hampton attorneys were infuriated by Judge Hertzberg's decision, and immediately filed an interlocutory appeal with the Commonwealth Court, a court whose jurisdiction is limited to cases where the government is a party. Mr. Bentivegna says. "At that point, things definitely took a turn for the worse. The Commonwealth Court simply buried the case. No hearing. No argument. No decision. No nothing."
Now sensing he was a man on a mission, Mr. Bentivegna next filed an Application for Extraordinary Relief with the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. "Neither the School District, Allegheny County, nor the Pennsylvania Attorney General even bothered to respond," he says. "The Supreme Court simply denied the application without comment."
Mr. Bentivegna notes that all judges, lawyers, and public officials in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, including school board directors, are supposedly required to take an oath to "support, obey, and defend" our federal and state constitutions. While he is clearly disillusioned with the way things turned out, he nevertheless feels strangely vindicated. "The case is now four years old," he states. "No one- not the school district, the county, nor the attorney general- has ever attempted to actually defend of the constitutionality of the statute. Were they to do so, they would only be making fools of themselves. Censoring me is their only option."
Last week, the Bentivegnas filed a Civil Rights action with the United States District Court, against the Hampton Township School District, Hampton Township, Allegheny County, and the BPAAR. Also individually named are eleven of the Hampton Township School District Board Members: Jill Hamlin, Denise Balason, Matthew Jarrell, Joy Midgley, Robert Shages, Gregory Stein, Larry Vasko, Trisha Webb, Jenny Kennedy, Bryant Wesley, and Maureen Perkins. "The Hampton School Board welcomes newcomers into their community by filing lawsuits against them. Their policy is to target and freeze concentrated tax increases on a relatively small group of their most vulnerable citizens. They really ought to be ashamed of themselves," Mr. Bentivegna says.
The Federal District Court has assigned the case to Senior Judge Joy Flowers Conti. The Bentivegnas are being represented by Attorneys George R. Farneth II and Nicholas A. Miller, both of Pittsburgh.
