| | For Immediate ReleaseJanuary 27, 2025 – Grand Rapids, Michigan Explain it like I'm 5: US Birthright citizenship. Once upon a time, there was a big house called America, where lots of people lived together like a huge family. This family had some special rules about who could stay and become part of the family forever. (Citizenship) Family Rules on CitizenshipOne of the most important rules in America was that if a baby was born inside this big house, that baby could automatically become a part of the family. But there was a catch! ("...subject to the jurisdiction thereof" catch). Now, in this big house, there lived a nice couple named Mr. and Mrs. Smith. They had a daughter named Jane. One day, Jane had a baby in the house. Since Jane and her baby were part of the Smith family, the baby could stay and be a part of all the family fun, games, and decisions. This baby, just by being born there, was like saying, "I belong here, and I'll follow our family's rules!" (like owing allegiance to the sovereign power of the United States) Visitors and WorkersNow, let's think about a friend of the Smiths, Jeff, who was just visiting to learn some new skills. (Student Visas). Jeff wasn't part of the family but was allowed to stay for a while. If Jeff had a baby while he was there, that baby wouldn't automatically become part of the Smith family. They were just visiting! Or imagine Maria, who came to the house to help with the cooking. She had a baby while she was working there. That baby, like Jeff's, wasn't meant to stay forever; they were just there because Maria was working (H1B, Work Visas etc) Also, a family renting their vacation guesthouse had their baby at the house. This baby wasn't born to join the Smith family either; they were just visiting and passing through. (Tourists/Visitor Visas) Squatters or Illegal AliensBut here's where it got tricky. There were some people who didn't ask for permission to come in; they just snuck into the big house and started living in the old shed out back. These were called "squatters." (Illegal Aliens). One night, a squatter had a baby right there in the shed. Even though this baby was born in the house, the baby wasn't born to someone who was supposed to be there and not to someone who was living in the house like a family member. (the real meaning of subject to our Jurisdiction). ArgumentsThings got really bad when the squatters started arguing with the Smith's family. They said because things were tough back home, and that they had no other place to go, the Smiths should allow their baby to become part of the Smith family. After all, the baby was born at the Smith house. The Rule of Birthright CitizenshipThe rule was clear but there was a catch. "...subject to the jurisdiction thereof" means, if you're born in the house and your parents are meant to be part of the family or connected to it in a special way (like Marriage or Green Card holders as addressed in US v Wong) then you get to stay and play. But if your parents were just visiting, working there for a short time, or not supposed to be there at all, like the squatters, you don't automatically get to join the family! So, the big house of America decided that only babies born to people who were truly meant to be part of the family would get to enjoy all the fun, responsibilities, and privileges of being in this big, wonderful family. And that's how the rule of birthright citizenship works in America. Austin ChengeVeteran and Former Republican Gov Candidate for MichiganAlma Mater: The University of Birmingham Law School, England. Note: This press release was issued by The Office of Austin Chenge to reflect on the anticipated legal battle over the Trump Administration's Executive Order on Birthright Citizenship.

"Once upon a time, there was a big house called America, where lots of people lived together like a huge family. This family had some special rules about who could stay and become a part of the family forever. (Citizenship) In this charming animated story, and video, I use my legal background to explain the concept of birthright citizenship in America through a heartwarming story. Meet the Smith family and their adventures in the big house called America, where rules about who gets to automatically join the family (Citizenship) are revealed in a simple, relatable way." Austin Chenge, US Army Veteran and Former Republican Governor Candidate for Michigan. | | | | | | | | | For Immediate ReleaseJanuary 27, 2025 – Grand Rapids, Michigan Explain it like I'm 5: US Birthright citizenship. Once upon a time, there was a big house called America, where lots of people lived together like a huge family. This family had some special rules about who could stay and become part of the family forever. (Citizenship) Family Rules on CitizenshipOne of the most important rules in America was that if a baby was born inside this big house, that baby could automatically become a part of the family. But there was a catch! ("...subject to the jurisdiction thereof" catch). Now, in this big house, there lived a nice couple named Mr. and Mrs. Smith. They had a daughter named Jane. One day, Jane had a baby in the house. Since Jane and her baby were part of the Smith family, the baby could stay and be a part of all the family fun, games, and decisions. This baby, just by being born there, was like saying, "I belong here, and I'll follow our family's rules!" (like owing allegiance to the sovereign power of the United States) Visitors and WorkersNow, let's think about a friend of the Smiths, Jeff, who was just visiting to learn some new skills. (Student Visas). Jeff wasn't part of the family but was allowed to stay for a while. If Jeff had a baby while he was there, that baby wouldn't automatically become part of the Smith family. They were just visiting! Or imagine Maria, who came to the house to help with the cooking. She had a baby while she was working there. That baby, like Jeff's, wasn't meant to stay forever; they were just there because Maria was working (H1B, Work Visas etc) Also, a family renting their vacation guesthouse had their baby at the house. This baby wasn't born to join the Smith family either; they were just visiting and passing through. (Tourists/Visitor Visas) Squatters or Illegal AliensBut here's where it got tricky. There were some people who didn't ask for permission to come in; they just snuck into the big house and started living in the old shed out back. These were called "squatters." (Illegal Aliens). One night, a squatter had a baby right there in the shed. Even though this baby was born in the house, the baby wasn't born to someone who was supposed to be there and not to someone who was living in the house like a family member. (the real meaning of subject to our Jurisdiction). ArgumentsThings got really bad when the squatters started arguing with the Smith's family. They said because things were tough back home, and that they had no other place to go, the Smiths should allow their baby to become part of the Smith family. After all, the baby was born at the Smith house. The Rule of Birthright CitizenshipThe rule was clear but there was a catch. "...subject to the jurisdiction thereof" means, if you're born in the house and your parents are meant to be part of the family or connected to it in a special way (like Marriage or Green Card holders as addressed in US v Wong) then you get to stay and play. But if your parents were just visiting, working there for a short time, or not supposed to be there at all, like the squatters, you don't automatically get to join the family! So, the big house of America decided that only babies born to people who were truly meant to be part of the family would get to enjoy all the fun, responsibilities, and privileges of being in this big, wonderful family. And that's how the rule of birthright citizenship works in America. Austin ChengeVeteran and Former Republican Gov Candidate for MichiganAlma Mater: The University of Birmingham Law School, England. Note: This press release was issued by The Office of Austin Chenge to reflect on the anticipated legal battle over the Trump Administration's Executive Order on Birthright Citizenship. | | | | | | | | This email was sent from .

| | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT:Oregon Republican PartyLaJuana Decker, Communications Chaircommunications.chair@oregon.gop

Release Date: January 27, 2025
PRESS RELEASE:
Eighty years ago today, on January 27, 1945, soldiers marched into Auschwitz to liberate thousands of prisoners left near death as the Nazis retreated. What they saw that day shocked the world. And it still shocks us today on Holocaust Remembrance Day 2025. On this day we remember the attempted genocide of a people villainized, ostracized, and killed based on their religious beliefs. And we say ‘Never again.’ On this day we remember the government-sponsored propaganda that turned a nation against innocent men, women, and children because of their ethnicity and their religion. And we say ‘Never again.’ On this day we remember those who boldly stood up for the Jewish people and who perished in the death camps with them. We must not trivialize this darkest moment in modern history by irresponsibly labeling political opponents as Nazis. We must remember the real atrocities that the world witnessed that day—the dehumanization of fellow human beings. As we honor their memory, we also reaffirm our commitment to learn from the lessons of the past. In the words of Holocaust survivor Elie Wiesel, “I belong to a generation that has learned that whatever the question, despair is not an answer; whatever the experience, indifference is not an option...Why write memories? Why share experiences? For the dead, it is too late. We do all this because it is not too late for our children, for all children. It is never too late.” Today, we remember. For the children. ####

body:
Honoring the Past, Shaping the Future

| | | | [ ](https://oregon.gop/)
---
| | Friend, Eighty years ago today, on January 27, 1945, soldiers marched into Auschwitz to liberate thousands of prisoners left near death as the Nazis retreated. What they saw that day shocked the world. And it still shocks us today on Holocaust Remembrance Day 2025.
---
| | [ ](https://links.infooregongop.com/els/v2/3rKqtRvwD7sg/NEwrRlo5Y003NUQ1aWc3V1lUb0VNeFVnVDR3aHFIZCtvbUkzbGdoeUw1aG40cjBVbjZPTjF2VXZ3VDFydTRhZDNRTDdjQW5QSkxnQVM2Mjg0QWZUZkYvNWE5S0gvcnFlMmZkaHlQRDF6M1U9S0/)
---
| | On this day we remember the attempted genocide of a people villainized, ostracized, and killed based on their religious beliefs. And we say ‘Never again.’ On this day we remember the government-sponsored propaganda that turned a nation against innocent men, women, and children because of their ethnicity and their religion. And we say ‘Never again.’ On this day we remember those who boldly stood up for the Jewish people and who perished in the death camps with them. We must not trivialize this darkest moment in modern history by irresponsibly labeling political opponents as Nazis. We must remember the real atrocities that the world witnessed that day – the dehumanization of fellow human beings. As we honor their memory, we also reaffirm our commitment to learn from the lessons of the past. In the words of Holocaust survivor Elie Wiesel, “I belong to a generation that has learned that whatever the question, despair is not an answer; whatever the experience, indifference is not an option...Why write memories? Why share experiences? For the dead, it is too late. We do all this because it is not too late for our children, for all children. It is never too late.” Today, we remember. For the children. Thank you, Oregon Republican Party

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101066088/524804083/1514584251?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNjEwOGIzNC1kZWRjLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uR2DPLEC919riTK7raLdjIyol-2g2UQUO9Y8jOelSTs=)
Peter, One of the first rules of propaganda is, “never allow the public to cool off.” It’s been one week since Donald Trump has been sworn in, and I can already see the headline fatigue on everyone’s faces. Rest and self-care is so important to strong, united organizing and results. That, as well as my own sanity, is why I promise you I will never email you each and every time Donald Trump acts out. None of us have the energy for that, and after a while it’s just shouting into the wind. But in these unique times, we _need_ to stay connected, and I will be reaching out around meaningful updates in Washington, key deadlines, and if (or more likely, when) our race heats up. That brings me to this: the first time I’m going to ask for your support in 2025. **It feels early, but National Republicans are already making decisions on which districts to target, and they’re already floating hit pieces on me to try and flip IL-17.** Trust me, I’d like a longer break too, but it’s the nature of the district. That’s also why it’s so important that we start this cycle with a strong fundraising close to January – nothing will have the NRCC avoiding our district like a large, early display of support that tells them to buzz off. And the earlier we can seal off a challenge, we can use that time and effort to help friends in red-to-blue districts around me so we can have a blue House to cut off the worst far-right impulses. [**So if you’re in this fight to keep our nation on track with me, I’m humbly asking you to pitch in $3 to help us close January with a message of intent. body:
It has only been one week, and so many good things have happened since the 2025 inauguration. President Trump was sworn in last Monday and | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=35751bdc56)

---
| | Peter,

It has only been one week, and so many good things have happened since the 2025 inauguration. President Trump was sworn in last Monday and has already done so much to help our country get back on track.

Even in just one week it is easy to miss things. Below, I have compiled a list of 26 actions that have happened in this last week that I hope are useful to you.

My goal is to provide you with a quick list of "highlights" in order for us to understand the positive changes that are already being made. It is not a comprehensive list, so if you feel I have missed something important, please let me know. In a few days, I plan to email a more detailed analysis of a few of the items that I think you may benefit from.

Hope you are doing well,
Neil
---
| [Throwback - Watch the New Direction Ad](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a4d04a431b&e=5a45ee1154 "Throwback - Watch the New Direction Ad")
---
|
1. In his inauguration speech, Trump started by indicating that, “The golden age of America begins right now.”[1]
2. Today, Trump is meeting with Congressional Republicans to talk about priorities for this next year, including the need to keep and expand the Trump tax cuts that are set to expire at the end of this year if not action is taken.
3. Military members who were discharged for not getting the Covid vaccine can be reinstated with full rank, full back pay.[2]
4. He has declassified the records for the assassinations of President JFK, Senator RFK, and Martin Luther King, Jr.[3]
5. He indicated that the Panama Canal cannot remain in communist China’s control. Secretary Rubio will visit Panama this week.[4]
6. In his inauguration speech, Trump indicated that, “we will pursue our manifest destiny into the stars, launching American astronauts to plant the Stars and Stripes on the planet Mars.” [5]
7. He gave an extension for TikTok to be able to operate while looking to comply with the law that they need to be American-owned.
8. Laken Riley Act has passed the House and the Senate with Trump to sign soon. The bill is named after Laken Riley, a Georgia nursing student who was killed in 2024 by an illegal immigrant. The bill requires the detention of unauthorized immigrants accused of theft and violent crimes.
9. He issued pardons and commutations for 1,500 January 6 defendants, many of whom were unfairly targeted and prosecuted.
10. He has appointed his top cabinet picks with 4 already confirmed.
11. He signed an executive order to end Birthright Citizenship. 22 states have already sued to keep it, but this executive order started the conversation which will likely end up in the US Supreme Court. Just FYI, the 14th amendment did not provide birthright citizenship for 100 years after the amendment was passed.
12. **_Abortion Update:_**
1. Trump spoke remotely at the National March for Life Rally in DC on Friday. Vance spoke in person. Both indicated their support for the unborn.
2. He pardoned 23 peaceful, abortion-clinic protestors who had been unfairly charged.
1. Trump indicated that, “Twenty-three people were prosecuted who should not have been prosecuted. Many of them are elderly people. They should not have been prosecuted.....This is a great honor to sign this.”[6]
3. He signed an executive order to reinstate the Mexico City Policy that restricts foreign organizations receiving U.S. global health funding from providing and promoting abortion with other sources of financing.
4. He signed an executive order to enforce the Hyde Amendment, which bans the use of federal funds for elective abortions domestically.
13. Trump signed executive orders to withdraw from:
1. The World Health Organization
2. The Paris Climate Accord
14. He declared a national energy emergency to expedite domestic production.
1. Signed an Executive Order directing all Federal agencies to suspend, revise, or rescind all Federal policies that restrict American energy production.
2. Reopen the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge (ANWR) in Alaska for energy development
3. Reversing burdensome regulations that impeded Alaska’s ability to develop its vast natural resources.
4. Vowed to reduce energy costs by 50% within a year to ease financial burdens on American families
5. Unleash American energy production in order to bring costs down for American families.
15. Terminated the Biden administration’s electric-vehicle-only mandate. This should also be good news for car buyers in Maryland as we hope that Wes Moore’s electric-only vehicle mandate is struck down.
16. Stopped all federal DEI programs.
1. In his inaugural speech, he indicated that, “I will also end the government policy of trying to socially engineer race and gender into every aspect of public and private life. We will forge a society that is color blind and merit based.”
17. Paused all new and renewed federal leasing and permitting for both onshore and offshore wind projects.
18. Securing America's Borders
1. Declared a national emergency at the southern border to allow the government to gain operational control of the border, combat the cartels, and secure our nation.
1. Signed an executive order that designated cartels and other organizations as foreign terrorist organizations and specially designated global terrorists.[7]
2. Signed an Executive Order requiring Homeland Security officials to deport aliens with orders of removal and prioritizing the prosecution of immigration criminal offenses.
3. Signed an Executive Order to enhance federal vetting and screening of aliens, requiring officials to identify which countries are not cooperating with United States officials in providing basic information on individuals seeking to enter the United States.
4. Signed an Executive Order pausing the operation of the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program (USRAP) to suspend the entry of aliens into the United States when such entry is not in the national interest.
5. Shut down the CBP One App that encouraged illegal immigration.
6. Signed an Executive Order to end catch-and-release programs.
7. Signed an Executive Order to resume the successful Migrant Protection Protocols (MPP) policy, also known as “Remain in Mexico.” This program requires migrants seeking asylum to stay in Mexico until the US is able to hear their asylum case, rather than simply releasing them into the United States with a promise to come back for their hearing.
8. Signed an Executive Order directing the Secretaries of Defense and Homeland Security to finish construction of a physical barrier along the southern border.
9. Signed an Executive Order designating international cartels and transnational gangs Foreign Terrorist Organizations.
10. Signed an Executive Order directing the military to prioritize our own borders and territorial integrity in strategic planning for its operations.
19. Draining The Swamp, Targeting Government Corruption
1. Signed a Presidential Memorandum ordering agencies to take all necessary steps to terminate remote work.
1. In part, it reads, "of all departments and agencies in the executive branch of Government shall, as soon as practicable, take all necessary steps to terminate remote work arrangements and require employees to return to work in-person at their respective duty stations on a full-time basis, provided that the department and agency heads shall make exemptions they deem necessary."
2. Signed an Executive Order establishing and implementing the President’s Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) to oversee a substantial reduction in the size and scope of government. This past week, DOGE has already taken actions that will save taxpayer dollars and reduce waste.
3. Signed an Executive Order reforming the Federal hiring process to restore merit to government service and re-prioritize skills, experience, and patriotism, not commitment to radical ideologies.
4. Signed an Executive Order instilling accountability for failing career bureaucrats to better address misconduct or poor performance.
5. Signed an Executive Order to create a new category of federal hires for career employees in policy-influencing positions, making it easier to remove rogue bureaucrats without lengthy delays and red tape.
6. Signed an Executive Order to bring a swift end to the weaponization of the federal government.
7. Signed an Executive Order to restore freedom of speech and end government-sponsored censorship, rectifying years of government abuse.
1. The order states: "The First Amendment to the United States Constitution, an amendment essential to the success of our Republic, enshrines the right of the American people to speak freely in the public square without Government interference. Over the last 4 years, the previous administration trampled free speech rights by censoring Americans’ speech on online platforms, often by exerting substantial coercive pressure on third parties, such as social media companies, to moderate, deplatform, or otherwise suppress speech that the Federal Government did not approve. Under the guise of combatting 'misinformation,' 'disinformation,' and 'malinformation,' the Federal Government infringed on the constitutionally protected speech rights of American citizens across the United States in a manner that advanced the Government’s preferred narrative about significant matters of public debate. Government censorship of speech is intolerable in a free society."
8. Issued a Presidential Memorandum to the heads of all executive departments and agencies ordering an immediate halt to the publication of regulations.
20. Restoring American Greatness
1. Signed a Policy Directive declaring that the United States' foreign policy must always put the interests of America and its citizens first.
2. Signed an Executive Order to realign U.S. foreign aid to match American values.
1. Secretary Marco Rubio issued a 90-day pause on all foreign aid, with exceptions for Israel and Egypt, according to a new State Department memo Friday.
3. Signed a Presidential Memorandum reviving his America First trade agenda.
4. Signed an Executive Order reinstating the name Mount McKinley and renaming the Gulf of Mexico as the Gulf of America.
5. Signed a Presidential Memorandum to deliver emergency price relief for American families by ordering all Federal agencies to eliminate unnecessary administrative expenses, counterproductive requirements, and harmful climate policies that are driving up costs.
21. Bringing Back Common Sense
1. Signed an Executive Order restoring the death penalty.
2. __**Signed an Executive Order requiring the Federal government to recognize the biological reality of two sexes — male and female.**__
22. Rescinded 78 Biden-era executive actions.
1. These included erasing Biden’s open border policies, radical DEI orders, and climate extremism that contributed to high inflation.
23. Regulatory freeze. No more regulations until Trump officials have control of the government. Also, instituted a hiring freeze of federal civilian employees.
1. The order does not apply to "military personnel of the armed forces or to positions related to immigration enforcement, national security, or public safety."
24. Visited North Carolina Hurricane victims.
25. Went to Los Angeles to look at the fire damage and see how to help.
26. Ordered a 180-day formal review of FEMA.[8]

A 919,900% return, gone.
By the time most heard about Uber's disruption of the taxi industry, it was too late.
But history has a way of offering second chances.
Mode Mobile is doing to the $500B smartphone industry what Uber did to taxis. But instead of turning cars into income streams, [Mode is turning phones into money-makers](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJyMz0-vlDAUBfBPU3aQ9vbfzIKFSsYY44vGjb7NpJTLUMMFXlsgz09vmExm7bbnl557HC1j6N9rZj8ygCF0iQEw-YEBvP3eKa5_6OvnEuTr3_LNvJA-Uvj0oBs88eRd8_rj5-1MaUvt_q1fjPy1iSfP7ws-8aO0QnJhPF5tU3S17DuuCqyFlSfO5VnwYqjPveLSq15rDZ1olbai7w0Ye2p7aVRbhBo4aC7AipMWilcA0rZWofBn7aVWTPF7T-UIY_BOpLy7GOeZKj9TMdZDzku6H3ZhcAnThilXNHdIcxtGPNQRycua6ZrmNXpksukoRry5YSZkYI6IsAsrMdl8dzFPGLUsuSh3F69HWbm2GK9-bd308N7R4sJtYrJ5wT2NmDPG65dGGs0ZmDw5wvQf3xWx7pY9jGNIxjLFb_e1x7athn8BAAD__w1MlxE). The results?
* 45M+ users earning income from their phone usage
* $325M+ already saved & earned by users
* 32,481% revenue growth (Deloitte's #1 fastest-growing software company)
* $60M+ in revenue and growing

Friends,

As we head into the second week of the Trump administration, concerns surrounding Trump’s promised mass deportations are reaching a fever pitch.

Less than a day after taking office, Trump rescinded a longstanding policy that prevented federal immigration enforcement from making arrests at schools and other sensitive locations, like hospitals and houses of worship

Taking advantage of this, a teacher in Texas made headlines yesterday by **urging ICE to raid his school** , claiming that many of his students “don’t even speak English.”****

In the same vein, I believe it is our _duty_ and _responsibility_ as teachers to do everything in our power to protect our students from surveillance, searches, and immigration arrests at schools.**

As teachers, we are the front lines of the resistance to Trump's mass deportations.**

I am a public school teacher, Dad, and Democrat running for Congress in the Special Election for Florida’s 6th Congressional District—and with _Republicans holding the smallest House Majority since 1932_ , if we win in April, we paralyze the GOP’s ability to pass its anti-immigrant legislative agenda.****

I won’t back away from that fight. I’m used to hard work — and I know this team is too.
But right now, **we’re coming up on the very first end-of-month fundraising deadline since we launched this campaign.**
What we’re able to raise before then will determine the strength of our campaign and will power everything we’re able to do for the next weeks and months ahead. The fight for strong leadership depends on us.
**[Grassroots donations to emails like this one are a key driver of our campaign. | | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: One week in
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
A quick guide to Trump’s executive orders 🚩 →
#
Donald Trump has been President for one week and has already issued 51 executive actions, including orders, proclamations, and official memos.1
_So much_ news has broken about Trump’s second term this last week that it’s been hard to keep track. We want to take a moment to break down some of the actions that raise the most red flags:
* Trump's first proclamation issued a “**full, complete, and unconditional” pardon for all 1,583 insurrectionists** facing charges for storming the Capitol on January 6th, including leaders of white supremacy groups facing felony sentences for seditious conspiracy or assaulting a police officer.2

* Trump declared two national emergencies: a **national energy emergency** and a **southern border emergency** due to immigration.
* The **national energy emergency is the first in U.S. history** , and grants Trump expanded power to roll back environmental protections, usher in new permitting, and deliver on his inaugural promise to **“drill, baby, drill.”**
* To that end, Trump opened the Alaska wilderness to more drilling, **halted offshore wind farms** on federal waters, and **withdrew the U.S. from the Paris Climate Agreement** (for the second time), joining Iran, Libya, and Yemen as the only nations uncommitted to reducing greenhouse gas emissions.3
* On immigration, Trump authorized **immigration raids on school campuses** , is weighing using the military to assist with deportations, and signed an order to **limit birthright citizenship** , defying a common interpretation of the 14th Amendment (which grants citizenship and equal protection under the law to all persons born in the United States). **A federal judge has already temporarily blocked this executive action.** 4

* Trump declared the U.S. federal government would **define sex as solely male or female** in accordance with their sex at time of conception.5
* Trump **restored the death penalty on a federal level** , and committed to ensuring that states that practice it have a “sufficient supply” of lethal injection drugs.

In addition to the above, Trump withdrew the U.S. from the World Health Organization, created a new government department — the Department of Government Efficiency — to be helmed by billionaire donor Elon Musk, and ordered the renaming of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America.
Let us be clear: many of these actions are likely to be challenged in court.
Our day-to-day actions are tremendously important in authoritarian regimes. We do not have to comply with illegal activity — **even if that illegal activity is coming from the President of the United States.**

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Multi-agency operation targeted immigrants in Austin and San Antonio,** " Texas Tribune's **Pooja Salhotra** -- "Agents from multiple federal agencies carried out immigration enforcement operations in Austin and San Antonio on Sunday, federal officials said.

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with the Drug Enforcement Agency, the FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives collaborated on "enhanced targeted operations" in both cities, an ICE spokesperson said. A similar operation took place Sunday morning in the Rio Grande Valley, [a local station reported](https://substack.com/redirect/14ca054c-e65d-46bb-8ac1-36ffe0261b59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The spokesperson said the operations were to "enforce U.S. immigration law and preserve public safety and national security by keeping potentially dangerous criminal aliens out of our communities." The official did not say what kind of offenses the targeted individuals were suspected of committing or whether anyone was detained.

KXAN [first reported](https://substack.com/redirect/2994c650-0fad-4dd4-b428-c7f6f63ecc68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ICE was conducting an operation in the Austin area on Sunday afternoon through a spokesperson for the DEA's Houston division. DEA spokesperson **Sally Sparks** said the agency's Houston office "mobilized every agent in our division," whose jurisdiction spans from Brownsville to Corpus Christi, Del Rio and Waco.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/5b30c910-4a86-4165-b2dd-9d416844e10f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"We got information that we had to mobilize, so we mobilized," Sparks told The Texas Tribune. "The majority of our agents assisted."

A Houston DEA [post on X](https://substack.com/redirect/762ecb8a-ee51-4fe1-80f0-6f18e18613ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday showed photos of law enforcement officers in a residential area escorting a man in handcuffs.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/5b30c910-4a86-4165-b2dd-9d416844e10f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Neither ICE nor the DEA answered questions about the scale of the operations. Spokespeople for the Travis and Bexar counties' sheriff's offices said they had not been notified of the operations. A spokesperson for U.S. Rep. **Lloyd Doggett** , D-Austin, said Doggett did not receive advance notice that ICE would conduct an operation in Austin.

Sunday's operations came less than one week after President Donald Trump began his second term as president and promised mass deportations across the country. Trump issued more than a dozen immigration-related executive orders last week, including [halting the use of an app](https://substack.com/redirect/474510a7-858e-44df-960a-4c940c5b2cbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that lets migrants make appointments to request asylum and authorizing immigration officers to raid sensitive locations such as churches, schools and hospitals." TOP NEWS "Multi-agency operation targeted immigrants in Austin and San Antonio, " Texas Tribune's Pooja Salhotra -- "Agents from multiple federal agencies carried out immigration enforcement operations in Austin and San Antonio on Sunday, federal officials said. U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with the Drug Enforcement Agency, the FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives collaborated on "enhanced targeted operations" in both cities, an ICE spokesperson said. A similar operation took place Sunday morning in the Rio Grande Valley, . The spokesperson said the operations were to "enforce U.S. immigration law and preserve public safety and national security by keeping potentially dangerous criminal aliens out of our communities." The official did not say what kind of offenses the targeted individuals were suspected of committing or whether anyone was detained. KXAN ICE was conducting an operation in the Austin area on Sunday afternoon through a spokesperson for the DEA's Houston division. DEA spokesperson Sally Sparks said the agency's Houston office "mobilized every agent in our division," whose jurisdiction spans from Brownsville to Corpus Christi, Del Rio and Waco. "We got information that we had to mobilize, so we mobilized," Sparks told The Texas Tribune. "The majority of our agents assisted." A Houston DEA on Sunday showed photos of law enforcement officers in a residential area escorting a man in handcuffs. Neither ICE nor the DEA answered questions about the scale of the operations. Spokespeople for the Travis and Bexar counties' sheriff's offices said they had not been notified of the operations. A spokesperson for U.S. Rep. Lloyd Doggett , D-Austin, said Doggett did not receive advance notice that ICE would conduct an operation in Austin. Sunday's operations came less than one week after President Donald Trump began his second term as president and promised mass deportations across the country. Trump issued more than a dozen immigration-related executive orders last week, including that lets migrants make appointments to request asylum and authorizing immigration officers to raid sensitive locations such as churches, schools and hospitals." U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with the Drug Enforcement Agency, the FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives collaborated on “enhanced targeted operations” in both cities, an ICE spokesperson said. A similar operation took place Sunday morning in the Rio Grande Valley, . The spokesperson said the operations were to “enforce U.S. immigration law and preserve public safety and national security by keeping potentially dangerous criminal aliens out of our communities.” The official did not say what kind of offenses the targeted individuals were suspected of committing or whether anyone was detained. KXAN ICE was conducting an operation in the Austin area on Sunday afternoon through a spokesperson for the DEA’s Houston division. DEA spokesperson Sally Sparks said the agency’s Houston office “mobilized every agent in our division,” whose jurisdiction spans from Brownsville to Corpus Christi, Del Rio and Waco. » “We got information that we had to mobilize, so we mobilized,” Sparks told The Texas Tribune. “The majority of our agents assisted.” A Houston DEA on Sunday showed photos of law enforcement officers in a residential area escorting a man in handcuffs. » Neither ICE nor the DEA answered questions about the scale of the operations. Spokespeople for the Travis and Bexar counties’ sheriff’s offices said they had not been notified of the operations. A spokesperson for U.S. Rep. Lloyd Doggett , D-Austin, said Doggett did not receive advance notice that ICE would conduct an operation in Austin. Sunday’s operations came less than one week after President Donald Trump began his second term as president and promised mass deportations across the country. Each week, the Center for Reproductive Rights will preview the Senate confirmation hearings for Trump nominees who pose a threat to reproductive rights. Research, legislative records, public statements, and more can be found at [**_Repro Red Flags: Agency Watch_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101069009/524814258/1207998042?sourceid=1150334&utm_campaign=25emege-0104aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=nominations&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWMyZTI1Yy1lNWRjLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T8rIJXwkjh3yxIm7ErbjR3xDU4rlTyaIyDff5REwdwg=&emci=c772794e-08d9-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=19c2e25c-e5dc-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237). **Confirmation Hearings This Week: 1/27 - 2/2** | **January 29 (Senate Finance) and 30 (Senate HELP): HHS Secretary - Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.**

**In This Role He Could:**
* Fund fake abortion clinics through the Title X program, diverting funds away from real medical centers that provide birth control, STD testing, abortion services, etc.
* Restrict coverage for birth control and Plan B for more than 16 million women of reproductive age enrolled in Medicaid.
* Steer the FDA to make it much harder to access abortion pills nationwide by reinstating old regulations on mifepristone or rescinding approval altogether.

| **Red Flags:**
* Frequently repeats anti-abortion talking points stigmatizing abortions later in pregnancy.
* Has major ties to the anti-science community and founded the leading vaccine disinformation organization.
* Has said he wants to ban abortion after a certain point in pregnancy, a view that has no basis in medicine or science.

---
* * *
**At Last Week's Hearings:**
* Doug Collins (Secretary of Veterans Affairs nominee) refused to answer whether a veteran who is raped in Texas would be able to get an abortion at a VA health care facility. He repeatedly indicated he would enforce a decades-old, obsolete law (Veterans Health Care Act of 1992) banning the VA from providing any abortion care.
* [**Russell Vought**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101069010/524814259/1444626316?sourceid=1150334&utm_campaign=25emege-0104aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=nominations&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWMyZTI1Yy1lNWRjLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T8rIJXwkjh3yxIm7ErbjR3xDU4rlTyaIyDff5REwdwg=&emci=c772794e-08d9-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=19c2e25c-e5dc-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237) (Office of Management and Budget nominee) said he will implement the president's anti-abortion agenda, and stated that President Trump is against exceptions to abortion bans for rape, incest, or life of the pregnant person.
* [**Marco Rubio**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101069011/524814260/388218248?sourceid=1150334&utm_campaign=25emege-0104aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=nominations&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWMyZTI1Yy1lNWRjLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T8rIJXwkjh3yxIm7ErbjR3xDU4rlTyaIyDff5REwdwg=&emci=c772794e-08d9-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=19c2e25c-e5dc-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237) was confirmed as Secretary of State, where he is expected to implement the [**Global Gag Rule**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101069012/524814261/1717650529?sourceid=1150334&utm_campaign=25emege-0104aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=nominations&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWMyZTI1Yy1lNWRjLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T8rIJXwkjh3yxIm7ErbjR3xDU4rlTyaIyDff5REwdwg=&emci=c772794e-08d9-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=19c2e25c-e5dc-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237), limiting abortion access worldwide.

clean_body: | | | Peter, I want to be one hundred percent straight with you: | | We the People know how to spend the money we earn. We the People know how to live our lives for God. We the People know how to raise our children to be good citizens. But the government gets in the way by spending our future away and taxing us to death, eroding religious liberty, and by stealing parental rights. Over the last 50 years, unelected bureaucrats have amassed nearly unlimited power to legislate away our freedoms. We the People MUST have a say. Leftists across the country have decided that following the law is optional. Without the rule of law, we will descend into chaos and be made to submit to the whims of the deep state. But when our laws are followed and enforced, peace, prosperity, and safety follow. Our military must make good on its promises, and America must command respect across the globe. If our military and its leaders aren’t strong, we will NEVER see peace again. There’s no sugarcoating it. Washington Democrats have stolen your future and the future of your children by overspending trillions of dollars. The value of our dollar will NEVER recover and will continue to lose value unless we cut spending like it’s hair in a barbershop. But if we simply spend less than we take in, we WILL restore our value and create hope for the future. Taxes kill businesses and regulations kill innovation. Everyone knows this. It’s not some secret that you learn at an Ivy League Business School. If we cut taxes and eliminate ridiculous regulations, our economy will boom. We did it during President Trump’s first administration and created the strongest economy in the history of mankind. Protect the lives of the innocent. Honor marriage and family as the cornerstone of our civilization. Judge people by the content of their character, not by the color of their skin. Acknowledge that all are created equal. These are the principles that made America the greatest, most free country in the history of mankind. | | Every single person in Washington, D.C. knows that if we follow these principles, our country will come roaring back and be the bastion of freedom that it once was. But not everyone wants that to happen. Sincerely, Speaker Mike Johnson | | | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana |

Peter –
Last week, Donald Trump was officially inaugurated as President of the United States. Trump spent the last decade instilling fear and mistrust in our democracy, and one of his first actions as president was pardoning the over 1,500 people charged with crimes related to the January 6 insurrection, including those who were charged with assaulting police officers.
Trump is trying to rewrite the history of the January 6 insurrection, but we will not let that happen.
Trump's actions on day 1 of his presidency have sent the message: the election conspiracy era is far from over.
The shadow of Trump’s misinformation machine has attempted to erode the foundation of our country time and again. Now, as we watch the first 100 days of his presidency unfold, we must double down on our efforts to strengthen our democracy. From continuing to register eligible voters across the country, to getting involved in elections at every level and supporting candidates who will protect and defend the will of the people, our work does not stop.
If we’ve learned anything over the last eight years, it’s that we defend our rights by working together.
No matter what Trump attempts to do as president, I will continue to do my part in Colorado to keep our state a safe haven for women, workers, and all eligible voters.
Thanks for being in this fight.
Jena Griswold

name: Team Yass
subject: The youngest new member
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Yassamin Ansari for Congress
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/79097/images/YA%20-%20Congress%20-%20Logo%20-%20Primary%201%20%5BRGB%5D_Full_Color_Coral.png]
Women To Watch In The 119th U.S. Congress Freshman Class
— Forbes, January 15, 2025
"In the House, Yassamin Ansari, a Democratic representative from Arizona's 3rd district, had already solidified her rising star status when she was voted the House Democrats' freshman class president. Ansari, who previously served on the Phoenix City Council, is Congress' youngest new member at 32 years old. In a Congress that's older than the last—the third oldest in history, in fact—with a tendency to elevate older members to higher ranks, Ansari's leadership role lends a rare voice of authority to an underrepresented generation."
PITCH IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ya-em-jan25]
Peter,
This is one of the oldest sessions of Congress in our nation’s history. That makes it all the more important that we uplift young, fresh voices like Yassamin’s to fully represent the interests of every community.

For the last few years, we have held revivals across America that have drawn hundreds of thousands of people desperate for breakthrough and a move of God. name: Chuck Rocha
subject: Join 50+ Organizations and 400+ Leaders at RootsCamp 2025 – Register Today!
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| Dear Progressive Leaders and Advocates, **Over 50 progressive organizations** are coming together at **RootsCamp 2025** , including **America Votes, SEIU, NGP VAN, Color of Change, Berlin Rosen, and Movement Voter Project**. Attendees will include groups like **Greenpeace, Working Families Party, and Advocacy Atlas** , along with over **400 participants from 120+ organizations** committed to resisting harmful policies and building a better future. **[Click here to register](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=601017ae17&e=b8f90417f9)** RootsCamp 2025 is our opportunity to strategize, collaborate, and mobilize to fight back. Happening **February 6–8** at the **Maritime Conference Center in Maryland** , this pivotal gathering is where we’ll unite to develop the tools, connections, and strategies needed to face the challenges ahead. **Why You Should Join Us:**
* **Strategize:** Learn from progressive leaders about tactics to resist harmful policies.
* **Collaborate:** Build coalitions to protect vulnerable communities.
* **Mobilize:** Strengthen our movement to reclaim the House and secure our democracy.

**Here’s what we’re up against:**
* **Weaponizing Government:** Plans to politicize the federal workforce and undermine accountability, targeting nonpartisan civil servants and democratic institutions.
* **Persecuting Communities of Color:** Amplifying harmful rhetoric and policies that criminalize immigrants, disenfranchise voters of color, and escalate discriminatory practices.
* **Attacks on Immigrant Rights:** Pushing to end birthright citizenship, restrict refugee admissions, and separate families at the border.
* **Climate Rollbacks:** Abandoning international climate agreements, opening protected lands to oil drilling, and slashing environmental justice programs.
* **Picking Fights with Neighboring Countries:** Engaging in unnecessary disputes with allies, straining relationships and threatening cross-border cooperation.
* **Dismantling Diversity:** Eliminating diversity, equity, and inclusion programs and fostering a divisive, exclusionary agenda.

But we’re not backing down. This is a moment of reckoning. It’s up to us to fight for the future we believe in. [** **](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=1ecb613d78&e=b8f90417f9)**[Click here to register](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=19ccabee5a&e=b8f90417f9)** Join the fight by attending, **[sponsoring scholarships](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=940e80a446&e=b8f90417f9)** , and promoting RootsCamp 2025. Together, we can resist, persist, and organize for the change our country desperately needs.

Contact Roberto Nava at roberto@solidaritystrategies.com if you have any questions. Let’s take action—because the future of our democracy depends on it. In solidarity,
**Chuck Rocha**

Team — here’s what’s going on with birthright citizenship:
First, on Day One of his second term, Donald Trump signed an executive order revoking birthright citizenship — a unilateral attempt to completely rewrite the definition of citizenship in the Constitution.
Then, a federal judge temporarily blocked Trump’s order, calling it “blatantly unconstitutional.”
Now, we need to speak out to show that Americans will not stand for this attack on our country’s values — or our Constitution.
SIGN ON HERE → [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4zynBaxryEWhqhhydkM6tw2]
Birthright citizenship was added to our Constitution with the passage of the 14th Amendment after the Civil War — it was meant to correct the Supreme Court’s 1857 Dred Scott decision, a ruling that held that African Americans, even those born free in the United States, could never be American citizens.
Now, Trump is acting directly contrary to the plain meaning of the Constitution — and is attempting to move the U.S. back to a pre-civil war mentality where certain kinds of people are viewed as subordinate and unequal because of their parents' status or ancestry.
If you agree with Tim Kaine that we can’t stand by quietly while Trump attacks birthright citizenship, please add your name today to say you support it. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4zynBaxryEWhqhhydkM6tw2]

That’s my son James in the photo above.I’m writing to you because I’ve spent the last eight years fighting tooth and nail to keep school-appointed counselors, and out-of-control judges from transitioning my son James against my will and against all reason.You may have heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or on Fox News.I am James’s father, but because I refused to accept that my 5 YEAR OLD boy should be surgically and chemically castrated......I’ve watched the school system, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.Just recently, an LA Court ruled that my ex-wife is free to proceed with castrating my son James. That’s why I’m writing to you today. **[I need your help.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=ad459531511846019f0e0dc2b04608b1&_e=GK-G-NRG1AUMJXMetNyPOFtySYIZ2JaWQScRgRhvz35cEz-rbksdzOIyNf3WIaQ5pDYLam-f9TkQGK3JL2LGH3eJgXAqu0i26BeBOjOIPJtQUEeGdCZ7kgmGhfO34qmWHn7AJebvJvSqTg6Q4uP58HVy4gLsEbCDijJh-uQvyeEw3MyL22VK-eW9BwoF_AqHmMvov5BPu2CQwLdk3jC0NONNHkMoZJEC7_dMdlXqLQoqoV4B-MBOybvU7VrrChvDtOKPq73DO-3YlHhdLd_wn8GRjnQEJw-KVDtRIgPaPVwjyqHNb57VDT-QYx9WE7WMQRSKAtBcwIHoLkXZKppVNj6wc9Ek103JZcDCsO1CgwBvaOGxNOz8zWBN7D1hbNNv)** I’m up against radical trans-activist judges, the 6 BILLION dollar trans lobby, and coastal elites forcing their LGBTQ+ agenda down our throats. They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees... They’re trying to break my spirit... I want to keep fighting, but I can’t do it alone. If you’re with me in the fight to **Save James** , **[would you consider making a generous $25 contribution to my Legal Defense Fund today?](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=ad459531511846019f0e0dc2b04608b1&_e=GK-G-NRG1AUMJXMetNyPOFtySYIZ2JaWQScRgRhvz35cEz-rbksdzOIyNf3WIaQ5pDYLam-f9TkQGK3JL2LGH3eJgXAqu0i26BeBOjOIPJtQUEeGdCZ7kgmGhfO34qmWHn7AJebvJvSqTg6Q4uP58HVy4gLsEbCDijJh-uQvyeEw3MyL22VK-eW9BwoF_AqHmMvov5BPu2CQwLdk3jC0NONNHkMoZJEC7_dMdlXqLQrKiNojt6iLxsf-XC2JOwLdac5G01uKocfFkL2KbIJGes5sHAnhup8mfvjhleoRcB6AlwZ-bEp1Gi2E86h5Szn2widLFAvGfC9r5gJSD1Ah1qSjoNjkCOMqgK0YcpQLCRY6rnWqsoh6IDOLSCgkUDf9)** But I’m getting ahead of myself...Let me start at the beginning. When James was just two years old, my ex-wife began saying our boy James was actually a girl.I told her she was wrong, and I kept dropping my son off at school in boy’s clothes because **he is a boy**. clean_body: I’m writing to you because I’ve spent the last eight years fighting tooth and nail to keep school-appointed counselors, and out-of-control judges from transitioning my son James against my will and against all reason| | | I don’t even know what my son looks like now. | | | | | | My Dear Friend, My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’m writing to you because I’ve spent the last eight years fighting tooth and nail to keep school-appointed counselors, and out-of-control judges from transitioning my son James against my will and against all reason.You may have heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or on Fox News.I am James’s father, but because I refused to accept that my 5 YEAR OLD boy should be surgically and chemically castrated......I’ve watched the school system, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.Just recently, an LA Court ruled that my ex-wife is free to proceed with castrating my son James. That’s why I’m writing to you today. I’m up against radical trans-activist judges, the 6 BILLION dollar trans lobby, and coastal elites forcing their LGBTQ+ agenda down our throats. They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees... They’re trying to break my spirit... I want to keep fighting, but I can’t do it alone. If you’re with me in the fight to Save James , But I’m getting ahead of myself...Let me start at the beginning. When James was just two years old, my ex-wife began saying our boy James was actually a girl.I told her she was wrong, and I kept dropping my son off at school in boy’s clothes because he is a boy. (I can’t believe I have to say that.) I later found out that the school counselors were changing him into girl’s clothes once he got to school WITHOUT MY KNOWLEDGE to inflame this delusion.Then during the custody battle, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.The court-mandated supervisor would ONLY let me see James if I put him in girl’s clothes. I have never affirmed the lie that my son is a girl, nor will I ever affirm it.So I was forced to stop visiting him.It broke my heart.Do you see what we’re up against? I can confirm that these trans-activist judges are presiding over kangaroo courts where common sense goes right out the window.They need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And James needs to be saved from their butchery. I am under a gag order currently to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Obviously, I’m not abiding by that order because it’s blatantly unconstitutional.But that’s not even the point.If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time. But I’m not just some activist.I’m a Dad.I’m fighting to save my son.And I will never give up on James.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers. I authored the bill in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee that outlawed sex change surgeries for minors.I then spent every dollar I had to make sure cowardly politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair. I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, but then my ex-wife just took James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state.And there was nothing I could do to stop it.And that’s the scary part:If this can happen in Texas, it can happen anywhere. Then in California, the radical judge railroaded me and gave my ex-wife free reign to proceed with the castration.I can’t even appeal the case because he sealed all the court records...I’ll have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process...On top of that, the other side is trying to make ME pay THEIR legal fees...Do you see what we’re up against? But if Conservatives won’t put up a fight, how will we ever win? That’s where Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) comes in. They heard about my case and immediately offered to stand by my side. | | | | | | | The fact is, if you care about keeping your children or grandchildren safe...If you want to save my son James from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again...And if you want to send a message to these radical judges that their day of reckoning has come...Then you’ll need someone who knows how these kangaroo courts ACTUALLY operate, and someone who’s willing to do WHATEVER it takes to save his son and every other kid like him.I humbly submit to you that I am that man. Your Warrior on the Frontlines,Jeff Younger P.S. I need your help to save my son. I have fought for a decade to keep radical activists and judges from transitioning my son against my will and against all reason. I have lobbied politicians, wiped out my life’s savings, and spent thousands of hours in court trying to save my son. Would you please rush me your I need your help, and I need to know that I’m not alone in this fight. Patriot's Legal Defense Fund601 Baffie Avenue Winter Park, Florida 32789

##### _Let 's Address This _periodically publishes pieces by scholars and national thought leaders on the human rights issues that impact us. State Senator Nabilah Islam Parkes is the first American Muslim elected to the Georgia Senate, and is now serving in her second term. Below is her compelling piece on how Democrats can win back working class voters. Please read and share.
* * *
## **How Democrats Can Win Back the Working Class**
**By State Senator Nabilah Islam Parks**
Kamala Harris's loss this past November showed that millions of working class and middle class American families -- including in Gwinnett County, which I represent in the State Senate -- have lost trust in the Democratic Party. It was a wakeup call. Democrats need to win those voters back. And the election of a new DNC chair on February 1st is an opportunity for us to set a new course, and remind those working families that it's the Democrats who are fighting for them every day.
After our loss to Donald Trump in 2016, we organized to turn Georgia blue -- and we can do it again. I worked at the Democratic National Committee in 2017 and 2018 to build the infrastructure we needed to swing voters our way. Then, as we prepared for the 2020 election, I served as a senior advisor for the Gwinnett County Democratic Party, Georgia's second-largest county party. Our work paid off: Joe Biden won Georgia, and Gwinnett moved 12 points further into the Democratic column.
But to do the same again, we need to return to our roots, as the party of American workers and their families. We need to make sure our priorities reflect the kitchen-table concerns of ordinary families, so everyone will have a fair shot at the American Dream - just like my parents had when they decided to raise me here.
### Learning From History
Ever since FDR's New Deal, Democrats were the steadfast advocate for labor unions, working families, and those striving for a better future. Meanwhile, for decades GOP policies have sucked money from the pockets of working families into the bank accounts of billionaires and bankers, and now a grifter who can't speak five sentences without a lie has recaptured the presidency.
Donald Trump pretends to be on the side of regular Americans -- and then pushes for tax cuts for billionaires, and tariffs that will make everything more expensive. And yet Trump and the GOP managed to convince millions of families that they, not the Democrats, were the party of working people: in November, almost half of union households voted GOP. They included not just white families, but Black, Latino and Asian American families, too.
Make no mistake - Democrats have made some important steps in the right direction, laying the groundwork for an economy built from the bottom up. However, workers and their families have not felt enough of the benefit, and the positive long-term economic investments that the Biden Administration made are not paying off quickly enough for those at the bottom of the ladder. Rising job numbers and a booming stock market are good, but if the gains don't effectively reach family budgets, they're not enough.
### The Struggle Is Real
Never mind getting ahead; many of my constituents can barely keep from falling behind, in an economy rigged in favor of CEOs and billionaires. Maybe you're one of them: from nurses to teachers to restaurant and retail workers to receptionists to delivery drivers, Georgians are watching their healthcare and childcare costs continue their decades-long increase, paying more for gas and groceries, seeing their rent go up. Over the last decade, the median rent in my local Gwinnett County went up more than [40 percent](https://substack.com/redirect/c01225d6-3d3c-48fc-afc7-925bc282ebcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), compared to [17 percent](https://substack.com/redirect/7cd27008-d841-4614-af69-7cbc109f466d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) nationwide. Neither of these are acceptable given the minimum wage has remained stagnant and wealth and income inequality continues to increase.
In my own district, working Americans of all races and cultures are feeling the pinch, including immigrants like my parents, first-generation Americans like me and my husband, and those whose families have been here for a century. They need Democrats to fight for them. And to be sure, I understand the vicious misogyny and racism Vice President Harris faced as a Black and Asian woman -- I faced and continue to face it myself every day as an Asian American woman. And I understand that was one of multiple factors that influenced the outcome, and at the polls most voters [prioritize their economic security](https://substack.com/redirect/b013c1f7-0cfc-4c48-a9dd-2493069f964a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over anything else.
As the mother of a newborn, I know young parents are hit hard by the costs of raising a family, which I'm trying to address in the State Senate; I introduced a bill to make baby products like diapers, cribs and strollers tax-exempt. Manufacturing workers and tradespeople need job security, and apprenticeships, and wages that stay ahead of inflation. Everyone needs protection from price-gouging that hits hardworking families hardest, and from bullying by giant corporations that crushes struggling small business owners.
### Listening to Voters Is a Non-Negotiable
Voters are telling us they're hurting, and our party needs to do a better job of listening. We need to be taking our policy, strategy, and messaging cues from working class people, not from big donors and Wall Street. That's the only way we'll rebuild trust - and reinvigorate our communities.
Listening to our families is the only way to ensure our policies are delivering what our families need. Listening is what I hope our new DNC chair will do -- and will push our entire party to do. The stakes couldn't be higher: over the next four years, working families will bear the brunt of policies that favor the wealthy and powerful over everyday Americans.
I won reelection in November by a ten-point margin by practicing what I preach. I've never forgotten my roots as the child of immigrants who came to Gwinnett County to seek a better life for our family. I listened to working people like them across my district and made sure my words and my policies reflected what they said. Government is for the people; that's why I ran, and why I serve.
### The Future Is Hopeful If We Act Now
If Democrats show families we're willing to fight for them, they'll come back to us. Our new chair needs to make sure we organize in every community across Georgia and the nation. Our chair needs to make sure we craft policies that respond to what we hear. We did it in 2020. I know we can do it again. And when we do, we'll win. Sometimes politics is just that simple.
_**Nabilah Islam Parkes is Georgia State Senator for District 7. Readers may contact Senator Islam Parkes at nabilah@nabilahislam.com.**_

Here’s our no-BS rundown on these cruel and baseless executive actions:
* Trump declared a “national emergency” at the border so he could use the military against people seeking safety, close the border, and continue building his senseless border wall.
* He invoked an over 200-year-old law once used to intern Japanese-Americans in camps to target immigrants all across the country for mass deportations.
* Trump also reinstated the cruel “Remain in Mexico” policy which forces asylum seekers into vulnerable conditions while their cases are heard.
* He even attacked birthright citizenship, threatening the 14th Amendment.

**Peter, t****hese policies aren’t about safety. These Day One policies are designed to destroy families and rip our communities apart.**
We know that Trump’s attacks feel overwhelming, but our communities are stronger than their fear tactics, and we’ll defend each other no matter what. We’ve survived every attempt to silence, erase, and divide us, and we must continue to fight and send a clear message:
**We belong here — always have, always will.**
**[Silence isn’t an option when our rights and freedoms are on the line. That’s why we’re organizing, fighting back, and building a future where all of us are free. subject: Our son, Raja
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Raja for Congress
body:
Peter, we wanted to take the time to send you a note about someone very special to us: Our son Raja. He works so hard to deliver for his constituents while being the best father and son to his family. That’s why we’re stepping in today and asking you to chip in $14 before his very first End of Month Deadline of the year. We know he hates asking hard-working folks like you for money, but we also know how badly he’s relying on your support. A parent’s job never ends, so today, we’re asking for your help. We know it would mean the world to Raja to see your name on his list of contributions. What do you say, Peter: Can you help us and chip in $14 before Raja’s very first End of Month Deadline? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=14]

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=14 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=14] Us with Raja in Washington! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=14]

Peter, our family doesn’t come from money.

As parents, we taught Raja to work hard for every dollar he earned.

But we also taught him that there’s no shame in asking for help when you need it.

When we first immigrated to the United States, we lived in public housing and used food assistance for a time.

But we always knew Raja had what it took to defy the tough hand he was dealt.

We knew all our sacrifices were worth it when we watched him graduate from Harvard Law School, become a policy director for President Obama, and eventually, win a seat in Congress.

But what we’re most proud of is that Raja has spent his life fighting for people left behind by unfair systems.

Peter, our son has never taken anything for granted. Raja knows what it’s like to struggle. We know how life-changing it can be when we open doors for each other. Because that’s what others did for us. It’s why Raja is working so hard to make sure others have a shot to defy the odds too. We know this in our hearts: Raja is exactly who we need fighting for us in Congress. If you agree, we’re asking you to chip in $14 before Raja’s very first End of Month Deadline of the year. Can we count on you? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=14]

Chip in $14 immediately >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=14]

Chip in $24 immediately >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=24]

Chip in $100 immediately >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=100]
Or chip in another amount >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/raja-email-2025?amount=25]

Thank you,
Dr. K.S. and Vijaya Krishnamoorthi
Raja’s proud parents!Raja represents Illinois in Congress.
The son of Indian immigrants, Raja grew up for a time on food stamps and in public housing. He knows the struggles countless Americans face every day.
Now, Raja is leading the fight in Congress on prescription drugs, climate change, election reform, and a more inclusive economy.
But Republican special interests are funnelling cash to defeat strong Democrats like Raja.
He's counting on grassroots supporters to keep this campaign running strong.
Can we count on you to chip in $10 so Raja can keep up the good fight in Congress?

Friend,

January 20 was a rough day for a huge percentage of Americans, not just because Donald Trump was sworn in as president but because we’ve been hearing for months that he and his extremist agenda made inroads with young people like us.

While it’s true that Trump did gain ground with Gen Z and Millennials in 2024, **it’s even clearer that young Americans _like us_ are fighting back against his dangerous anti-youth agenda**. Trump’s win in November was excruciating and his presidency will be a clear setback to progress, __but we aren’t giving up__.

Actually, _**we’re fighting back**_. My name is **Sam Weinberg** , I’m a Gen Zer, and I’m writing to you as the **Executive Director of a 501(c)4 nonprofit called Path to Progress** , an organization that meets young people where they are to convey left-of-center policy priorities and engage young folks in the political process!

Case in point: **_just one Instagram post from our account reached almost 10 MILLION young people on Inauguration Day_**. We’re showing Gen Z and Millennials the threat Trump poses — and that we need to vote!
|
---
| [ ](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTQ0NzE2OTc4MTU5ODc5NTc0LFwiclwiOjE0NDcxNzAxNzMwOTUxMjcyN30iLCJzIjoiNGQ2YzIzMTM2NzE5YjJhNSJ9)
---
|
---
Lots of politicians and celebrities try too hard to “go viral” online. In reality, the key is just to be straightforward and authentic — and that’s exactly what we at **Path to Progress** do. That's why we’ve generated more than 230,000 followers on Instagram alone, not to mention X/Twitter, Threads, Facebook, and Bluesky.**

We’re re-engaging Americans under 40 in order to defeat the far-right once and for all** — and I’m _personally asking you_ to be in this fight with us. It won’t be easy but if we can reach 10 million people in just the first day of Trump’s second presidency, there’s no telling what we can do over the next four years!__
|
---
_**[Path to Progress is the only organization led by Generation Z that engages our peers with policy-based solutions instead of politics as usual. subject: This is our moment—RFK Jr. needs you
body:
This is your moment to make history. Act today and add your voice of support.

| | | [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmation_cta_1_27_25&n=1)

# RFK Jr. Needs You to Take Action!
---
Dear Na This is your moment to make history. Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s Senate confirmation hearings begin this **Wednesday, January 29** , and the outcome depends on voices like yours. With your help, we can secure a bold, fearless leader at the helm of the Department of Health and Human Services. Every call, every signature, and every letter sends a message loud and clear: the American people want leadership that stands up for truth and health freedom. Here’s how you can make a real impact right now:
1. **Submit a Letter of Support
******If you represent a business, organization, or are a notable public figure, your endorsement is powerful. Draft a letter of support and send it to[kennedyletters@mahaaction.com](mailto:kennedyletters@mahaaction.com) by _Tuesday, January 28, at 12 PM EST_.

Here are templates for both the **[Senate Finance](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=hrEZcvU67lMTCb_S2ZglZjWIHMF0YLMQUxpq5riC0pUdeTFSnDdkYSo5U8eRUJfblH37go-xtW37jHV_Un6WtcvX-FoFDXcbu9jUPqfG1q2vd6snbD4qR6Q4uWN1arfzeBTJ90JNLDCLp0atlLDUSQ&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmation_cta_1_27_25&n=2)** and **[Senate HELP](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=hrEZcvU67lMTCb_S2ZglZjWIHMF0YLMQUxpq5riC0pVxCFlYJVpzqSvX9p1_aoApelMdDOfxXiJ_Tmxgo_nBDDP2GXQYLClvKH0cPacRLz-OBdvHc_86pf_Y48TK5lj2kyqLKXVOf-8wCI-SeSfnyQ&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmation_cta_1_27_25&n=3)** Committees.

2. **Call Your Senators
** Your voice can tip the scales. A few minutes on the phone could influence your senators’ decisions. [Call them](https://www.mahaaction.com/contact-lawmaker?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmation_cta_1_27_25&n=4) before Friday, January 31, when the Senate may vote on RFK Jr.’s confirmation.

**[Find their contact info here](https://www.mahaaction.com/contact-lawmaker?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmation_cta_1_27_25&n=5)** and make the call. Stay concise, courteous, and clear about your support.

3. **Sign the Support Letter
** Join thousands of others in a unified message to the Senate: Confirm Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as Secretary of HHS. Every name added strengthens this call for action. **[Sign here](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=hrEZcvU67lMTCb_S2ZglZqLaXDYiAZfNIIePsxydvshdX-kZ6LjlT3g_wRJVZCLwESmN5rcelUoebKNb5_eYWwbyaIa0sZpjDplFnhPYB6oMLTHwLZNawo9QmmrnEwjIv_nOFYHCnoSLxBTSixJGlw&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmation_cta_1_27_25&n=6).**

This isn’t just about one man—it’s about changing the course of our nation’s health policies for generations to come. _Your voice matters more than you realize._ Thank you for standing with us in this historic moment. Together, we’ll make sure the Senate hears us loud and clear.
---

name: Kelvin King
subject: Welcome 2025- Meaningful Conversations w/ Key leaders underway!
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/lwfaa/mental-dialogue-to-present-ask-a-black-republican-featuring-kelvin-and-janelle-king-14186899?e=cb396c52a2)
---
| |
---
| |
## _Happy New Year!_
As we enter 2025, we reflect on last year’s focus on the election and the importance of encouraging non-traditional Republicans and minorities to vote for policies that truly benefit them. The collective effort of many certainly paid off and now the real work begins!
This year, we are dedicated to fostering meaningful policy dialogue and creating environments that help clarify the "why" behind political choices. We aim to achieve lasting impacts rather than temporary results.

We believe that focusing solely on party affiliation or candidates can create fickle voters. Instead, we strive to connect voters to their personal "why" by providing relevant information and allowing them to make informed choices that resonate with their values and needs. We look forward to empowering individuals and communities through informed decision-making this year, and we encourage you to join us for our upcoming events!
---
|
---
Join us for a unique opportunity to engage directly with the Lieutenant Governor of Georgia in a meaningful dialogue about the policies affecting our communities. This event is designed for individuals impacted by these policies to share their experiences and insights on critical issues.
| [RSVP](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=40f36ed7f9&e=cb396c52a2 "RSVP")
---
|
---
Join us at “When Women Succeed: Let’s Talk About the ‘F’ Word in the Workplace: Females!” for an evening of mentorship, leadership, and networking with some of the most inspiring female leaders. Designed for college-aged to early-career women, this event will equip you with the tools and insights you need for success in the workplace. Hear from an incredible panel of leading businesswomen in Atlanta, followed by an engaging Q&A session. Enjoy a mocktail and indulge in a creatively inspired savory and sweet charcuterie while networking with new friends and old.
| [RSVP](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=9a5282dedf&e=cb396c52a2 "RSVP")
---
| Thank you for taking the time to engage with us and these important events. We are eager to continue our journey together in 2025, fostering meaningful discussions and empowering individuals to make informed choices that align with their values. Together, we can create lasting change, we look forward to seeing you at our upcoming events, where we can connect and collaborate further. Here's to a productive and impactful year ahead!
---
